title: Fusion of Deep Learning Radiomics and Clinical Features for Individualized Prediction of Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy Response in Osteosarcoma.
zh_title: 深度学习影像组学预测骨肉瘤新辅助化疗反应
summary: 回顾性纳入198例，联合MRI深度学习影像组学评分与临床变量构建多模态模型预测化疗反应。
key_points: 比较12种CNN架构，DenseNet121交叉验证AUC最高（0.775）
影像组学评分与核心临床变量经逻辑回归融合
用Grad-CAM++与SHAP提供图像及特征层面解释
reason: 单中心回顾性、样本不足千例且仅内部交叉验证，属增量档
abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] Background: Stage IIB conventional osteosarcoma exhibits highly heterogeneous responses to neoadjuvant chemotherapy, necessitating reliable, noninvasive pre-treatment evaluation systems. Methods: This retrospective study of 198 patients utilized pre-treatment T2-weighted magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) and baseline clinical data. Twelve classical convolutional neural network architectures were benchmarked to identify the optimal imaging backbone. This selected radiomics score was then integrated with core clinical variables using logistic regression to construct a multimodal model. Gradient-weighted Class Activation Mapping++ (Grad-CAM++) and SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) algorithms provided image- and feature-level interpretability. Results: DenseNet121 achieved the highest mean cross-validated area under the curve (AUC; 0.775) and was selected, with AUCs of 0.797 (95% CI: 0.716-0.877) and 0.701 (95% CI: 0.513-0.877) in the training and test cohorts. Adding the clinical variables improved discrimination, yielding a test-cohort AUC of 0.827 (95% CI: 0.661-0.992) with significant reclassification gain over the radiomics-only model (NRI = 1.28, IDI = 0.177; DeLong p = 0.011). Grad-CAM++ activation concentrated on the solid medullary and extraosseous soft-tissue components, and SHAP ranked the radiomics score as the strongest contributor. Conclusions: Integrating deep learning radiomics with key clinical features provides a noninvasive tool for the individualized prediction of neoadjuvant chemosensitivity in osteosarcoma.
zh_abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)]【背景】IIB期经典型骨肉瘤对新辅助化疗的反应高度异质，因此需要可靠的、无创的治疗前评估系统。【方法】这项纳入198例患者的回顾性研究使用了治疗前T2加权磁共振成像（MRI）和基线临床数据。对12种经典卷积神经网络架构进行基准测试，以确定最佳成像骨干网络。随后使用逻辑回归将该选定的影像组学评分与核心临床变量整合，构建多模态模型。梯度加权类激活映射++（Grad-CAM++）和SHapley Additive exPlanations（SHAP）算法提供了图像层面和特征层面的可解释性。【结果】DenseNet121获得最高的平均交叉验证曲线下面积（AUC；0.775）并被选中，其在训练队列和测试队列中的AUC分别为0.797（95% CI：0.716-0.877）和0.701（95% CI：0.513-0.877）。加入临床变量改善了区分能力，使测试队列AUC达到0.827（95% CI：0.661-0.992），并且相较于仅影像组学模型具有显著的重分类改善（NRI = 1.28，IDI = 0.177；DeLong p = 0.011）。Grad-CAM++激活集中在实性髓内和骨外软组织成分，SHAP将影像组学评分列为最强贡献因素。【结论】将深度学习影像组学与关键临床特征整合，为骨肉瘤新辅助化疗敏感性的个体化预测提供了一种无创工具。

title: Using an Artificial Intelligence Software Tool (iSeg) During Radiation Treatment Planning for Patients With Lung Tumors
zh_title: iSeg辅助肺癌放疗计划靶区勾画的临床试验登记
summary: 美国西北大学注册干预性试验，计划入组34例，评估AI工具iSeg基于CT生成肿瘤轮廓供医师复核修改的安全性与有效性，尚未招募。
key_points: 干预性试验，计划入组34例，状态为尚未招募
iSeg基于CT自动生成肿瘤轮廓供医师审核修改
尚无结果数据公布
reason: 仅为试验注册、无结果、样本小，属增量档。
abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Northwestern University; conditions: Lung Carcinoma, Lung Non-Small Cell Carcinoma, Metastatic Malignant Neoplasm in the Lung; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 34; status: NOT_YET_RECRUITING] This clinical trial studies whether an artificial intelligence (AI) software tool called iSeg can be safely and effectively used during routine radiation treatment planning for patients with lung tumors. Typical radiation treatment planning involves physicians manually outlining the tumors to plan where the radiation therapy will be delivered. This process can be time consuming and may vary between physicians. iSeg uses AI to analyze computed tomography (CT) images and generate a proposed tumor outline that can then be reviewed and modified by the treating physician during radiation treatment planning which may help improve accuracy and provide more consistent results and better planning. iSeg may be safe and effective to use during radiation treatment planning for patients with lung tumors.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：西北大学（Northwestern University）；疾病：肺癌、肺非小细胞癌、肺转移性恶性肿瘤；类型：干预性（INTERVENTIONAL）；分期：NA；入组人数：34；状态：尚未招募（NOT_YET_RECRUITING）] 本临床试验研究一种名为 iSeg 的人工智能（AI）软件工具能否在肺肿瘤患者的常规放射治疗计划制定过程中安全有效地使用。典型的放射治疗计划制定包括医生手动勾画肿瘤，以规划放射治疗的实施位置。这一过程可能耗时，并且可能因医生而异。iSeg 使用 AI 分析计算机断层扫描（CT）图像并生成建议的肿瘤轮廓，随后治疗医生可在放射治疗计划制定过程中对其进行审查和修改，这可能有助于提高准确性并提供更一致的结果和更好的计划。iSeg 在肺肿瘤患者的放射治疗计划制定过程中使用可能是安全有效的。

title: Demystifying Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Health care: Is AI Friend or Foe?

abstract: [Professional case management] The literature review is saturated with positive tones about the use of AI not only in health care but also in all aspects of our daily lives as well. The positivity range is extensive, ranging from increased accuracy, efficiency, productivity, profitability to creativity, equity, and advancement. Yet, the public is circumspect with continual exposure to news about cybersecurity threats or attacks, identity theft, violations of privacy, and challenges of establishing trust in their daily encounters with technology amidst prevalence of deep fakes, voice cloning, and AI-generated images or videos of people. A meta-synthesis of AI-related literature inclusive of expert panels is examined as an exploratory search for AI applicability and use in the health care landscape. The purpose of this article is to demystify AI highlighting areas of its use in health care, ways for clinicians specifically, care managers to bridge that divide and ascertain key practice standards with emphasis on its ethical use in health care. The settings using AI that were considered in this article include Health plans, Hospitals, medical practices or clinics, and Hospitals' Revenue Cycle Management (RCM). Implications and recommendations for case management engagement in AI are addressed relative to the standards of practice (SOPs).
zh_abstract: 【专业病例管理】文献综述中充斥着积极论调，不仅关于AI在医疗保健中的使用，也关于其在日常生活各个方面的使用。这种积极性的范围很广，从提高准确性、效率、生产力、盈利能力到创造力、公平性和进步。然而，公众在持续接触网络安全威胁或攻击、身份盗窃、隐私侵犯等新闻，以及在深度伪造、声音克隆和AI生成的人物图像或视频盛行的背景下，在日常与技术接触中建立信任面临挑战，因此态度谨慎。本文对包含专家小组在内的AI相关文献进行元综合，作为对AI在医疗保健领域适用性和使用的探索性检索。本文旨在揭开AI的神秘面纱，强调其在医疗保健中的使用领域，特别是临床医生、照护管理者弥合这一差距并确定关键实践标准的方式，重点是其医疗保健中的伦理使用。本文考虑的采用AI的场景包括健康计划、医院、医疗实践或诊所，以及医院的收入周期管理（RCM）。本文还针对实践标准（SOPs）讨论了病例管理参与AI的意义和建议。

title: DeepAVPred: A Deep Learning Framework Integrating RECM-DWT and BiGRU for Accurate Antiviral Peptide Prediction.
source: PubMed · International journal of molecular sciences
zh_title: DeepAVPred：抗病毒肽预测框架
summary: 提出DeepAVPred深度学习框架，整合RECM-DWT与BiGRU预测抗病毒肽。

reason: 同行评审提出新特征，但未见外部验证或临床转化，属增量档
abstract: [International journal of molecular sciences] Viral infections continue to pose a significant global health challenge. Antiviral peptides (AVPs) have emerged as promising therapeutic agents owing to their high specificity, favorable safety profiles, and broad-spectrum antiviral activity. However, experimental AVP identification is time-consuming and costly, while existing computational predictors often have limitations in predictive accuracy and feature representation. Here, we propose DeepAVPred, a deep learning-based framework for AVP identification. DeepAVPred integrates complementary sequence descriptors to capture physicochemical properties and pairwise residue interactions. We present a novel feature representation, the Residue Energy Content Matrix augmented with a Discrete Wavelet Transform (RECM-DWT). RECM-DWT characterizes multi-scale patterns in residue-energy information and complements conventional sequence descriptors by providing wavelet-derived features across multiple resolution levels. The integrated features are then modeled using an attention-based Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit (BiGRU) network to learn contextual dependencies and informative sequence patterns. On the AVPtrain dataset, DeepAVPred achieved strong performance in 10-fold cross-validation, with an accuracy of 0.990, a Matthews Correlation Coefficient (MCC) of 0.980, and an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) of 0.993. On the independent test dataset, AVPtest, DeepAVPred achieved an accuracy of 0.942, an MCC of 0.886, and an AUC of 0.949. These results demonstrate the predictive performance of DeepAVPred and support its potential as a computational framework for prioritizing candidate antiviral peptides for further experimental validation.
zh_abstract: [International journal of molecular sciences] 病毒感染持续构成重大的全球健康挑战。抗病毒肽（AVPs）因其高特异性、良好的安全性特征和广谱抗病毒活性而成为有前景的治疗药物。然而，实验性AVP鉴定耗时且成本高昂，而现有计算预测器在预测准确性和特征表示方面常存在局限。在此，我们提出DeepAVPred，一个基于深度学习的AVP鉴定框架。DeepAVPred整合互补的序列描述符，以捕获理化性质和成对残基相互作用。我们提出一种新的特征表示——残基能量内容矩阵结合离散小波变换（RECM-DWT）。RECM-DWT表征残基能量信息中的多尺度模式，并通过提供跨多个分辨率水平的小波衍生特征来补充传统序列描述符。随后，整合特征使用基于注意力的双向门控循环单元（BiGRU）网络建模，以学习上下文依赖性和信息性序列模式。在AVPtrain数据集上，DeepAVPred在10折交叉验证中取得强劲性能，准确率为0.990，马修斯相关系数（MCC）为0.980，受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）为0.993。在独立测试数据集AVPtest上，DeepAVPred达到准确率0.942、MCC 0.886和AUC 0.949。这些结果证明了DeepAVPred的预测性能，并支持其作为计算框架的潜力，用于优先选择候选抗病毒肽以进一步实验验证。

abstract: Invasion is an early step in the metastatic spread of triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC), yet cells within a single tumour or cell line differ in their capacity to invade, and it is unclear which transcriptional features distinguish cells that invade from those that do not. We re-analysed the public single-cell RNA-sequencing dataset GSE329526, in which ClonMapper-barcoded MDA-MB-231 cells were separated in a transwell assay into invasive (five samples, 6,289 cells) and non-invasive (five samples, 5,983 cells) fractions and compared with the parental population (one sample, 3,022 cells). An initial cell-level analysis combined Wilcoxon differential expression, an XGBoost classifier with a random cell split, SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) and Enrichr over-representation analysis. Because cells from the same sample are not independent, we then repeated the analysis at the sample level, using differential expression on sample means (five versus five), XGBoost with cross-validation that held out whole samples, a quality-control-metric baseline model, SHAP on held-out samples and rank-based gene-set enrichment analysis (GSEA). At the sample level, 6,651 of 11,727 tested genes differed between invasive and non-invasive samples (false discovery rate [FDR] < 0.05), including the ten top-ranked cell-level genes such as PHLDA2, ANTXR2, VIM and HMGA1 (FDR 0.0007 to 0.0022) and the epithelial-to-mesenchymal transition (EMT) regulators TGFBR2, JAG1, SDCBP and WWTR1. title: A Lightweight Attention-Based CNN with Saliency-Map Interpretability for Skin Cancer Detection
zh_title: 轻量注意力CNN结合显著图可解释性用于皮肤癌检测
summary: arXiv 预印本提出轻量注意力CNN用于皮肤病变二分类，在公开数据集上准确率87%，参数量约为MobileNet一半。

reason: 单数据集、指标小幅持平基线的预印本改进，属增量档
abstract: Skin cancer is among the most prevalent and life threatening forms of cancer worldwide. Early and accurate diagnosis significantly improves patient survival rates. However, manual dermoscopic assessment remains challenging due to visual similarity. This study proposes an Explainable AI-driven framework for automated binary classification of skin lesions using a lightweight attention-based convolutional neural network (CNN-Attention). The model integrates channel attention to focus on informative regions of dermoscopic images while maintaining low computational complexity. A publicly available dataset comprising 2,637 training and 660 test images was used, with balanced class weights. The proposed model achieved 87 percent accuracy with 1.95 million parameters and 7.45 MB of storage, matching the best baseline (MobileNet) while using approximately half as many parameters and half as much storage. ROC AUC and PR AUC scores reached 0.9475 and 0.9430, respectively. Additionally, saliency maps were incorporated as an explainability technique to visualize regions that influence model decisions. Comparative analysis with VGG16,VGG19,ResNet101,and MobileNet demonstrates the proposed models effectiveness in balancing classification results, computational efficiency, and interpretability.
zh_abstract: 皮肤癌是全球最常见且危及生命的癌症类型之一。早期、准确诊断可显著提高患者生存率。然而，由于视觉相似性，人工皮肤镜评估仍具挑战性。本研究提出一个可解释 AI 驱动框架，使用轻量级基于注意力的卷积神经网络（CNN-Attention）对皮肤病变进行自动二分类。该模型整合通道注意力以聚焦皮肤镜图像中的信息区域，同时保持较低计算复杂度。使用一个公开数据集，包含 2,637 张训练图像和 660 张测试图像，并采用平衡类别权重。所提模型在 195 万（1.95 million）个参数和 7.45 MB 存储下达到 87% 准确率，与最佳基线（MobileNet）相当，而参数数量和存储约减半。ROC AUC 和 PR AUC 分别达到 0.9475 和 0.9430。此外，纳入显著性图作为一种可解释性技术，以可视化影响模型决策的区域。与 VGG16、VGG19、ResNet101 和 MobileNet 的比较分析表明，所提模型在平衡分类结果、计算效率和可解释性方面具有有效性。

title: CTBakeGS: training-free baking of photorealistic CT volume renderings into 3D Gaussian splats

summary: 无需训练将CT体渲染转为3D高斯泼溅，便于在低算力设备实时显示。

abstract: Photorealistic volume rendering of computed tomography (CT) may convey anatomy intuitively, but it needs the CT data, dedicated software and a powerful graphics processor. Three-dimensional Gaussian splatting (3DGS) displays photorealistic scenes in real time on less powerful devices, but existing medical approaches train each scene for minutes to hours. We aimed to convert a CT volume rendering directly into a 3DGS model without training. Splats were placed on an adaptive octree of millimetre-sized cells. Their colour and opacity were computed on the graphics processor with the renderer's lighting, cell opacity was converted analytically into splat opacity, and faint splats were retained stochastically above the 1/255 opacity floor of standard 3DGS rasterisers. Six public CT scans (1.5-mm voxels) were converted with three transfer functions and compared with converged references by peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR), structural similarity and a learned perceptual metric. Two-million-splat models reached a PSNR of 32.6 +/- 0.9 dB for bone, 30.1 +/- 1.0 dB for contrast-enhanced vessels and 32.3 +/- 1.5 dB for skin and bone. A conversion pass (usually two or three per model) took 4-30 s on a current laptop and 9-60 s on a desktop with a 4-GB graphics card. On the laptop, the models rendered at 68 frames per second at 800 x 800 pixels. Training-free conversion produced real-time 3DGS models of photorealistic CT renderings in about a minute or less per conversion pass on ordinary computers, with fidelity that we consider sufficient for interactive viewing.
zh_abstract: 计算机断层扫描（CT）的真实感体绘制可直观呈现解剖结构，但需要 CT 数据、专用软件和强大的图形处理器。三维高斯泼溅（3DGS）可在性能较弱的设备上实时显示真实感场景，但现有医学方法对每个场景训练数分钟至数小时。我们旨在将 CT 体绘制直接转换为无需训练的 3DGS 模型。泼溅点被放置在毫米级单元的自适应八叉树上。其颜色和不透明度在图形处理器上结合渲染器的光照计算，单元不透明度经解析转换为泼溅点不透明度，微弱泼溅点在标准 3DGS 光栅化器 1/255 不透明度下限之上以随机方式保留。六份公开 CT 扫描（1.5-mm 体素）以三种传递函数转换，并通过峰值信噪比（PSNR）、结构相似性和一种学习感知指标与收敛参考进行比较。两百万泼溅点模型在骨达到 32.6 +/- 0.9 dB 的 PSNR，在对比增强血管达到 30.1 +/- 1.0 dB，在皮肤和骨达到 32.3 +/- 1.5 dB。一次转换遍历（每个模型通常两到三次）在当前笔记本电脑上耗时 4-30 s，在配备 4-GB 显卡的台式机上耗时 9-60 s。在笔记本电脑上，模型以 800 x 800 像素、68 帧/秒渲染。免训练转换在普通计算机上每次转换遍历约一分钟或更短时间内，生成真实感 CT 渲染的实时 3DGS 模型，其保真度我们认为足以用于交互式查看。

title: FORESEE-MS: Toward Prospective Spatial Forecasting of Future Multiple Sclerosis Lesions from Baseline FLAIR MRI
zh_title: FORESEE-MS：基于基线FLAIR预测未来多发性硬化病灶
summary: 提出评估框架，用人群先验图谱作基线，比较五种深度学习模型预测MS新病灶的能力。
key_points: 39例MSSEG-2受试者，5折交叉验证
评估指标含AUROC、AUPRC与患者内Recall@Top-K%

abstract: Traditional multiple sclerosis (MS) image analysis has primarily focused on retrospectively detecting and segmenting lesions. This study investigates whether baseline FLAIR MRI can identify regions at risk for future lesion formation beyond population-level spatial patterns. We introduce FORESEE-MS, an evaluation protocol that uses a fold-specific population-prior atlas as a baseline and assesses predictions using pooled voxel-level discrimination (AUROC and AUPRC) and within-patient lesion localization (Recall@Top-K%), with patient-level bootstrap confidence intervals. We evaluated five deep learning models (3D U-Net, Attn+ResBlock+VAE, ViT, and two SwinUNETR variants) using 5-fold cross-validation on 39 subjects from the MSSEG-2 dataset. The atlas achieved the highest pooled voxel-level AUROC and AUPRC, with no deep learning model reliably outperforming it on either metric. However, the 3D U-Net and Attn+ResBlock+VAE achieved higher mean voxel-level within-patient Recall@Top-K% than the atlas at all evaluated thresholds, although most paired confidence intervals for the differences included zero. These findings suggest that baseline FLAIR may contain patient-specific predictive information, but in this small cohort, it remains uncertain whether this information improves lesion forecasting beyond a population-prior atlas.
zh_abstract: 传统多发性硬化（MS）图像分析主要集中于回顾性检测和分割病灶。本研究探讨基线 FLAIR MRI 是否能够识别未来病灶形成风险区域，而不仅限于人群水平的空间模式。我们提出 FORESEE-MS，一种评估协议，其使用折叠特异性（fold-specific）人群先验图谱作为基线，并通过合并的体素水平判别能力（AUROC 和 AUPRC）以及患者内病灶定位（Recall@Top-K%）评估预测，采用患者水平 bootstrap 置信区间。我们在来自 MSSEG-2 数据集的 39 名受试者上使用 5 折交叉验证评估了五种深度学习模型（3D U-Net、Attn+ResBlock+VAE、ViT 和两种 SwinUNETR 变体）。该图谱获得了最高的合并体素水平 AUROC 和 AUPRC，且没有深度学习模型在任一指标上能够可靠地优于它。然而，3D U-Net 和 Attn+ResBlock+VAE 在所有评估阈值下均获得了高于图谱的平均体素水平患者内 Recall@Top-K%，尽管大多数差异的配对置信区间包含零。这些发现提示，基线 FLAIR 可能包含患者特异性预测信息，但在这个小队列中，尚不确定该信息是否能比人群先验图谱更好地改善病灶预测。

title: Enhancing Clinical Classifier Robustness with Deep Representation Learning Based OOD Detection on DNA Methylation Data
zh_title: DNA甲基化数据深度表征学习OOD检测

abstract: DNA methylation (DNAM) array-based tumor classification is a powerful clinical diagnostic tool, but models trained on fixed reference cohorts can produce faulty predictions for tumor types not represented in the training distribution. We propose an end-to-end deep representation learning-based out-of-distribution (OOD) detection framework for DNAm array data. Deep neural network (DNN) classifiers were trained on public sarcoma (SARC) (GSE140686) and brain tumor (BT) (GSE90496) cohorts, and feature vectors were extracted from bottleneck layers. Five OOD methods, including 1dimension (1D)-Subspace Analysis (1D-SSA), K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN), Ridge Regression, Mahalanobis Distance (MD), and Sum of Squared Distances (SSD), were explored with 200 and 500-dimensional embeddings. Spectral discrepancy was used to discriminate in-distribution (IND) from OOD samples. Performance was measured via cross-validation, holdout samples, and an independent clinical dataset. 1D-SSA was the most effective approach. In the sarcoma-IND/brain tumor-OOD setting, the framework achieved an AUROC of 0.975 and True Negative Rate (TNR)@95TPR of 0.930, and an AUROC of 0.9569 and TNR@95TPR of 0.8660 for the brain tumor-IND/sarcoma-OOD setting. On the independent clinical test set, the method yielded a mean AUROC of 0.976, a DE of 0.032, an FPR@95TPR of 0.065, and a TNR@95TPR of 0.935. These results show deep representation-based OOD detection as a practical quality-control layer for clinical-grade methylation-based tumor classification systems.
zh_abstract: 基于 DNA 甲基化（DNAM）芯片的肿瘤分类是一种强大的临床诊断工具，但在固定参考队列上训练的模型可能对训练分布中未代表的肿瘤类型产生错误预测。我们提出一种用于 DNAm 芯片数据的端到端、基于深度表示学习的分布外（OOD）检测框架。深度神经网络（DNN）分类器在公开肉瘤（SARC）（GSE140686）和脑肿瘤（BT）（GSE90496）队列上训练，并从瓶颈层提取特征向量。探索了五种 OOD 方法，包括一维（1D）子空间分析（1D-SSA）、K 近邻（KNN）、岭回归、马氏距离（MD）和距离平方和（SSD），使用 200 维和 500 维嵌入。谱差异用于区分分布内（IND）和 OOD 样本。性能通过交叉验证、留出样本和一个独立临床数据集进行测量。1D-SSA 是最有效的方法。在肉瘤-IND/脑肿瘤-OOD 设置中，该框架达到 AUROC 0.975 和 True Negative Rate（TNR）@95TPR 0.930；在脑肿瘤-IND/肉瘤-OOD 设置中，AUROC 为 0.9569，TNR@95TPR 为 0.8660。在独立临床测试集上，该方法产生平均 AUROC 0.976、DE 0.032、FPR@95TPR 0.065 和 TNR@95TPR 0.935。这些结果表明，基于深度表示的 OOD 检测可作为临床级基于甲基化的肿瘤分类系统的实用质量控制层。

title: Segmentation Confidence for Arbitrary CNNs

abstract: Convolutional neural networks (CNN) are widely used for medical image segmentation. However, they lack an inherent measure of confidence. Existing methods for estimating prediction uncertainty often require a custom network architecture and/or dedicated training setups and need to be trained from scratch. In addition, the deduction of a single confidence score per input from the uncertainty maps is not always straightforward. In this study, we explore voxel-based uncertainty estimation methods that can be added to existing segmentation pipelines without training from scratch. We also propose a novel method to estimate a single confidence score from the uncertainty maps. Our evaluations on different ROIs and modalities suggest that our confidence score can predict segmentation performance in unseen data.
zh_abstract: 卷积神经网络（CNN）广泛用于医学图像分割。然而，它们缺乏一种内在的置信度度量。现有估计预测不确定性的方法通常需要自定义网络架构和/或专用训练设置，并且需要从头训练。此外，从不确定性图推导每个输入的单一置信度分数并不总是直接明了。在本研究中，我们探索可添加到现有分割流程而无需从头训练的基于体素的不确定性估计方法。我们还提出一种从不确定性图估计单一置信度分数的新方法。我们在不同 ROI 和模态上的评估表明，我们的置信度分数可以预测未见数据上的分割性能。

title: Evaluating a Large Language Model for Emergency Triage Using Synthetic Clinical Dialogues: Toward a Multimodal Clinical Safety Framework.
zh_title: 大语言模型用于急诊分诊的合成对话评估

abstract: [Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)] Background/Objectives: Prioritizing patient safety through accurate emergency triage is critical during mass-gathering events such as Hajj and Umrah, where high patient volumes can significantly increase the risk of clinical errors. Although the Emergency Severity Index (ESI) provides a standardized triage protocol, it remains dependent on human judgment, while traditional artificial intelligence (AI) models often struggle to capture the nuanced clinical context embedded in patient narratives. To address this gap, this study evaluates GPT-5.2 using synthetically generated dialogues as a step toward a conceptual clinical decision-support framework that bridges structured electronic health records (EHRs) with triage interactions through clinical dialogues. By combining narrative inputs with structured physiological indicators, it explores the potential to support more informed clinical decision-making under controlled simulation conditions. Methods: To evaluate this contribution, we systematically assessed the role of clinical dialogues in triage performance using a balanced and stratified dataset of 1000 simulated Hajj-context scenarios. Results: The results demonstrate that incorporating clinical dialogues can significantly improve triage performance, with a 79.7% relative reduction in under-triage across all ESI levels. A more noticeable improvement was observed in high-acuity cases, with a 91.9% relative reduction in under-triage. In addition, the model achieved a high-acuity recall of 94.5%, highlighting its ability to identify critical "red-flag" symptoms that are often not captured in structured data. These findings suggest that narrative context may contribute to more accurate triage assessment and improved identification of high-acuity cases. Conclusions: Consequently, when evaluated within a controlled decision-support setting, this study suggests that large language model (LLM)-based systems may improve triage reliability and may contribute to safer triage decision-making in high-demand clinical environments.
zh_abstract: 《Diagnostics (Basel, Switzerland)》【背景/目的】通过准确的急诊分诊优先保障患者安全，在朝觐（Hajj）和副朝（Umrah）等大规模集会活动中至关重要，因为大量患者可能显著增加临床错误风险。尽管急诊严重度指数（ESI）提供了标准化分诊方案，但它仍依赖人工判断，而传统人工智能（AI）模型往往难以捕捉患者叙述中蕴含的细微临床背景。为弥补这一空白，本研究使用合成生成的对话评估GPT-5.2，作为迈向概念性临床决策支持框架的一步，该框架通过临床对话将结构化电子健康记录（EHR）与分诊交互连接起来。通过将叙述性输入与结构化生理指标相结合，它探索在受控模拟条件下支持更明智临床决策的潜力。【方法】为评估这一贡献，我们使用包含1000个模拟朝觐情境场景的平衡分层数据集，系统评估临床对话在分诊表现中的作用。【结果】结果表明，纳入临床对话可显著改善分诊表现，在所有ESI级别中，分诊不足（under-triage）相对减少79.7%。在高急症病例中观察到更明显改善，分诊不足相对减少91.9%。此外，该模型在高急症病例中达到94.5%的召回率，突出其识别结构化数据中常未捕捉到的关键“红旗”症状的能力。这些发现提示，叙述性背景可能有助于更准确的分诊评估和更好地识别高急症病例。【结论】因此，在受控决策支持环境中评估时，本研究表明基于大语言模型（LLM）的系统可能提高分诊可靠性，并可能有助于在高需求临床环境中实现更安全的分诊决策。

title: Artificial intelligence - driven toxicogenomics for predictive environmental and pharmaceutical safety.
zh_title: AI驱动毒理基因组学用于环境与药物安全预测
summary: 综述梳理支持向量机、随机森林与深度学习等在毒性早期预测与风险评估中的应用，称预测准确性优于传统毒理方法。
key_points: 聚焦多组学数据整合与毒性预测
方法涵盖SVM、随机森林与深度学习
称相对传统毒理学方法准确性有所提升
reason: 泛泛综述、无原始数据与对照，属增量档
abstract: [Frontiers in genetics] Toxicogenomics integrates high-throughput genomic technologies with toxicology to evaluate molecular responses to chemical and pharmaceutical exposures. The increasing volume and complexity of multi-omics data necessitate advanced computational approaches capable of extracting meaningful and predictive insights. In this context, artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML) techniques-including support vector machines, random forests, and deep learning architectures-are increasingly employed for early toxicity prediction and risk assessment, with reported improvements in predictive accuracy and sensitivity relative to conventional toxicological approaches. This paper explores the role of AI-driven toxicogenomics in enhancing predictive environmental and pharmaceutical safety. It highlights the application of ML-based and data-driven models for the integrative analysis of transcriptomic, proteomic, and metabolomic datasets to identify toxicity-associated biomarkers, elucidate mechanisms of action, and predict adverse drug and environmental effects prior to clinical manifestation. Notably, AI-driven models have demonstrated significant improvements in prediction accuracy, sensitivity, and scalability compared to traditional toxicological approaches, reducing reliance on animal testing and accelerating decision-making processes. Furthermore, the paper discusses the significance of AI-based toxicogenomics in drug development, environmental contaminant screening, and regulatory toxicology, while addressing key challenges such as data heterogeneity, model interpretability, and regulatory acceptance. The convergence of computer science and toxicogenomics represents a robust framework for next-generation predictive toxicology, facilitating safer pharmaceutical development, more precise environmental risk assessment, and evidence-based public health and regulatory decision-making.
zh_abstract: [Frontiers in genetics] 毒理基因组学（toxicogenomics）整合高通量基因组技术与毒理学，以评估对化学和药物暴露的分子反应。多组学数据数量和复杂性的不断增加，需要先进的计算方法能够提取有意义且具有预测性的见解。在此背景下，人工智能（AI）和机器学习（ML）技术——包括支持向量机（support vector machines）、随机森林（random forests）和深度学习架构（deep learning architectures）——越来越多地用于早期毒性预测和风险评估，据报道，相对于传统毒理学方法，其预测准确性和敏感性有所提高。本文探讨AI驱动的毒理基因组学在增强预测性环境和药物安全性方面的作用。文章重点介绍基于ML和数据驱动模型在转录组、蛋白质组和代谢组数据集整合分析中的应用，以识别毒性相关生物标志物、阐明作用机制，并在临床表现出现之前预测药物和环境不良效应。值得注意的是，与传统毒理学方法相比，AI驱动模型在预测准确性、敏感性和可扩展性方面已显示出显著改善，减少了对动物试验的依赖并加速了决策过程。此外，本文讨论了基于AI的毒理基因组学在药物开发、环境污染物筛查和监管毒理学中的意义，同时讨论了数据异质性、模型可解释性和监管接受度等关键挑战。计算机科学与毒理基因组学的融合代表了下一代预测毒理学的一个稳健框架，有助于更安全的药物开发、更精确的环境风险评估以及基于证据的公共卫生和监管决策。

title: Beyond Federated Learning: Decentralized Agentic Systems for Self-Evolving Clinical Intelligence
zh_title: 超越联邦学习：去中心化智能体系统
summary: 预印本观点文章提出以共享推理轨迹替代数据或参数聚合的去中心化智能体框架。
key_points: 主张从数据聚合转向经验聚合
智能体共享抽象推理轨迹而非原始数据
与联邦学习做概念性对比，无实证结果
reason: 观点性预印本，无实验验证，按观点档上限内取中低
abstract: Clinical expertise is inherently distributed: it resides not in any single dataset or institution but in the accumulated reasoning experiences of thousands of clinicians navigating diverse patient populations, resource constraints, and evolving treatment protocols. Yet current approaches to scaling medical AI, from centralized large language models to federated learning, remain anchored to a data-centric paradigm that treats knowledge as static parameters to be aggregated. In this Perspective, we argue for a fundamental shift from data aggregation to experience aggregation. We propose Decentralized Agentic Systems (DAS), a framework in which distributed AI agents operating across healthcare institutions synthesize collective clinical intelligence by sharing abstracted reasoning trajectories rather than raw data or model parameters. Unlike federated learning, which averages numerical gradients across homogeneous model architectures, DAS exchanges structured records of clinical reasoning, specifically the sequence of observations, hypotheses, tool invocations, and outcome feedback that constitute diagnostic experience. We examine the architectural principles, deployment considerations, governance requirements, and critical open challenges of this framework, laying the groundwork for a collaborative medical AI ecosystem where distributed expertise autonomously adapts to the complexities of longitudinal patient care.
zh_abstract: 临床专业知识本质上是分布式的：它并不存在于任何单一数据集或机构中，而是存在于成千上万名临床医生在应对多样化患者人群、资源约束和不断演变的治疗方案过程中所积累的推理经验之中。然而，当前用于扩展医学人工智能的方法，从集中式大语言模型到联邦学习，仍然锚定于以数据为中心的范式，该范式将知识视为待聚合的静态参数。在本 Perspective（观点）文章中，我们主张从数据聚合向经验聚合的根本性转变。我们提出去中心化智能体系统（Decentralized Agentic Systems, DAS），这一框架中，跨医疗机构运行的分布式 AI 智能体通过共享抽象化的推理轨迹，而非原始数据或模型参数，来综合集体临床智能。与在同质模型架构之间对数值梯度进行平均的联邦学习不同，DAS 交换结构化的临床推理记录，具体而言是构成诊断经验的观察、假设、工具调用和结果反馈序列。我们考察该框架的架构原则、部署考量、治理要求以及关键开放挑战，为一种协作式医学 AI 生态系统奠定基础，在该生态系统中，分布式专业知识能够自主适应纵向患者照护的复杂性。

title: Sequential versus fully conditional specification for tree-based synthesis of health data
zh_title: 健康数据树模型合成：顺序式与全条件式比较
summary: 预印本比较两种基于决策树条件分布的健康数据合成规范，用多项风险与效用指标评估合成数据质量。
key_points: 合成数据用于在隐私前提下开放科学共享
比较顺序式与全条件式两种合成规范
以多项风险与效用指标衡量合成质量
reason: 方法学比较类预印本，仅摘要信息、未见真实数据规模与结论，属增量档
abstract: Disseminating synthetic data in place of original ones is a promising way to enforce privacy while complying with open science principles, especially in the healthcare domain. To keep pace with the rate at which researchers collect such data, there is a need for fast and flexible synthesis procedures. A popular class of such procedures is based on models of conditional distributions induced by decision trees. Such models can be combined into a synthetic distribution following two main approaches: sequential specification and fully conditional specification. However, there is currently no recommendation on which specification to use to optimize the risk-utility tradeoffs. In this work, we use both specifications to synthesize medical datasets by combining tree-based models of conditional distributions. We compare the quality of the resulting synthetic data using several metrics of risk and utility. Our results indicate no general superiority of either specification over the other. Sequential synthesis seems sensitive to the ordering of the variables, while the fully conditional specification involves more hyperparameters and incurs higher computational costs, which may limit its suitability for off-the-shelf synthesis procedures.
zh_abstract: 以合成数据代替原始数据进行发布，是在遵守开放科学原则的同时强化隐私保护的一种有前景的方法，尤其是在医疗健康领域。为跟上研究人员收集此类数据的速度，需要快速且灵活的合成流程。一类流行的此类流程基于由决策树诱导的条件分布模型。这类模型可以按照两种主要方法组合成合成分布：序贯设定（sequential specification）和全条件设定（fully conditional specification）。然而，目前尚无关于应使用哪种设定来优化风险-效用权衡的建议。在本工作中，我们使用这两种设定，通过组合基于树的条件分布模型来合成医学数据集。我们使用若干风险和效用指标比较所得合成数据的质量。我们的结果表明，两种设定均不存在普遍优于另一种的情况。序贯合成似乎对变量的排序敏感，而全条件设定涉及更多超参数并产生更高的计算成本，这可能限制其适用于现成的合成流程。

title: SAP-ViT: A Self-Attributing Patch Vision Transformer for Medical Image Classification
zh_title: SAP-ViT：面向医学图像分类的自归因图块视觉Transformer
summary: 提出以末层图块嵌入直接聚合替代CLS令牌分类的视觉Transformer，使预测可分解为图块级贡献并加稀疏约束。
key_points: 预测由图块权重聚合成，前向即得归因
对图块权重分布施加稀疏正则以精简证据
引入输入空间回映射定位影响性输入图块
在多个医学图像分类数据集上做定性与定量评估
reason: 方法有新颖点但仅预印本内部多数据集评估，无外部验证与临床结局，属增量偏上
abstract: Vision Transformer (ViT) classifiers commonly rely on a global classification (CLS) token for image-level prediction, which is poorly aligned with local interpretability requirements in medical imaging. We propose SAP-ViT, a Self-Attributing Patch Vision Transformer that replaces CLS-based classification with direct aggregation of last-layer patch embeddings. This design makes class predictions decomposable into patch-level contributions as part of the forward pass. To encourage concise and readable evidence, SAP-ViT applies sparsity regularization to the patch-weight distribution. Since self-attention mixes information across patch tokens, we further introduce an input-space back-mapping mechanism to estimate which input patches contribute to influential output patch embeddings. We evaluate SAP-ViT qualitatively and quantitatively on multiple medical image classification datasets spanning different imaging modalities. The results show that SAP-ViT maintains strong classification performance while providing consistent and interpretable patch-level explanations across datasets. Ablation results further show that both sparsity regularization and the alignment component of input-space back-mapping contribute to the final explanation quality. Overall, SAP-ViT provides a favorable trade-off between predictive accuracy and interpretability for ViT-based medical image classification.
zh_abstract: Vision Transformer（ViT）分类器通常依赖全局分类（CLS）令牌进行图像级预测，这与医学影像中对局部可解释性的要求匹配不佳。我们提出 SAP-ViT，一种自归因块（Self-Attributing Patch）Vision Transformer，它用最后一层块嵌入的直接聚合替代基于 CLS 的分类。该设计使类别预测作为前向传播的一部分可分解为块级贡献。为鼓励简洁且可读的证据，SAP-ViT 对块权重分布施加稀疏正则化。由于自注意力会在块令牌之间混合信息，我们进一步引入输入空间反向映射机制，以估计哪些输入块对有影响力的输出块嵌入有贡献。我们在跨不同成像模态的多个医学图像分类数据集上对 SAP-ViT 进行定性和定量评估。结果表明，SAP-ViT 在保持强分类性能的同时，跨数据集提供一致且可解释的块级解释。消融结果进一步表明，稀疏正则化和输入空间反向映射的对齐组件都有助于最终解释质量。总体而言，SAP-ViT 为基于 ViT 的医学图像分类在预测准确性与可解释性之间提供了有利的权衡。

title: O2D-MedNet: An Optimization-Aware Dual-Domain Framework for Robust Medical Image Segmentation
zh_title: O2D-MedNet：优化感知双域医学图像分割框架
summary: arXiv 预印本提出双域医学图像分割框架，用退化感知双域交互与轮廓引导融合模块提升鲁棒性。
key_points: DDI 模块融合傅里叶与小波域特征，抑制退化响应
CGF 模块跨骨干做轮廓引导融合
摘要未给出数据集、对比结果与外部验证
reason: 预印本方法创新但无外部验证与量化结果，属增量档
abstract: Medical image segmentation (MIS) remains challenging due to composite degradations and multi-scale geometric variations, which jointly impair lesion-background separability, structural consistency, and optimization stability. Existing single-stream frameworks entangle heterogeneous cues within a single representation pathway, while hybrid-stream approaches often rely on generic or static fusion, limiting effective coordination across domains and failing to explicitly address optimization instability. To overcome these limitations, we propose a new optimization-aware dual-domain framework for MIS (O2D-MedNet). First, a degradation-aware dualdomain interaction (DDI) module integrates Fourier - and Wavelet-domain features to suppress degradation-sensitive responses while preserving structural and fine-detail information. Second, a cross-backbone contour-guided fusion (CGF) module enables selective interaction between CNN-based local detail modeling and visual state-space-based global structure modeling, improving boundary accuracy and representation consistency. Third, a gradient-context optimization (GCO) strategy stabilizes training by adaptively adjusting learning dynamics based on loss trends and gradient statistics, mitigating instability caused by class imbalance and heterogeneous sample difficulty. Extensive experiments on six benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over state-of-the-art MIS methods across multiple imaging modalities. Further analyses confirm enhanced sensitivity, structural consistency, and optimization stability, validating the effectiveness of the proposed O2D-MedNet for robust MIS under heterogeneous conditions.
zh_abstract: 医学图像分割（Medical image segmentation, MIS）由于复合退化与多尺度几何变化而仍然具有挑战性，这些因素共同损害病灶-背景可分离性、结构一致性和优化稳定性。现有的单流框架在单一表示路径中纠缠异构线索，而混合流方法通常依赖通用或静态融合，限制了跨域的有效协调，并且未能明确解决优化不稳定性。为克服这些局限，我们提出一种新的面向MIS的优化感知双域框架（O2D-MedNet）。首先，退化感知双域交互（degradation-aware dual-domain interaction, DDI）模块集成傅里叶域和小波域特征，以抑制退化敏感响应，同时保留结构和精细细节信息。其次，跨骨干轮廓引导融合（cross-backbone contour-guided fusion, CGF）模块使基于CNN的局部细节建模与基于视觉状态空间的全局结构建模之间能够进行选择性交互，提高边界准确性和表示一致性。第三，梯度上下文优化（gradient-context optimization, GCO）策略通过基于损失趋势和梯度统计自适应调整学习动态来稳定训练，减轻由类别不平衡和异构样本难度引起的不稳定性。在六个基准上的大量实验表明，在多种成像模态下，相较于最先进的MIS方法取得了一致改进。进一步分析证实了灵敏度、结构一致性和优化稳定性的增强，验证了所提出的O2D-MedNet在异构条件下实现鲁棒MIS的有效性。

title: Generative AI Simulated Patients Versus Expert Demonstration Videos for Psychiatric Interview Training in Occupational Therapy Students
zh_title: 生成式AI模拟患者用于精神科访谈教学试验
summary: 一项已完成注册的53人随机试验，比较生成式AI模拟患者与专家示范视频的精神科访谈教学效果。
key_points: 53名作业治疗学生随机分组
比较AI模拟患者与专家视频教学
以OSCE与访谈自我效能为结局
reason: 小样本注册试验、尚无结果，教育应用证据有限
abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: Chang Gung Memorial Hospital; conditions: Clinical Competence, Communication Skills, Self Efficacy; type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 53; status: COMPLETED] The goal of this study is to compare two methods for teaching psychiatric work-history interviewing to third-year occupational therapy students: practice with a generative AI simulated patient and an expert demonstration video. The main questions it aims to answer are: 1. Which teaching method leads to better interview performance in an objective structured clinical examination (OSCE) with a standardized patient? 2. How do the two methods affect students' interview self-efficacy? 3. How do students evaluate the two methods, and which learning sequence do they prefer? Students enrolled in a required vocational rehabilitation course were randomly assigned to one of two sequences. In the first teaching week, one sequence practiced interviewing a GPT-4o-based simulated patient (a 35-year-old person with schizophrenia), and the other watched and discussed an expert demonstration interview of the same case. Both groups completed a 9-minute standardized-patient OSCE on the same day. In the following week, the two sequences crossed over to the other method. Interview self-efficacy was measured before teaching, after the first method, and after the second method.
zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：长庚纪念医院；疾病/状况：临床胜任力、沟通技能、自我效能；类型：干预性（INTERVENTIONAL）；分期：不适用（NA）；入组人数：53；状态：已完成（COMPLETED）] 本研究旨在比较两种向三年级职业治疗专业学生教授精神科工作史访谈的方法：使用生成式人工智能模拟患者进行练习，以及观看专家示范视频。其主要拟回答的问题是：1. 在标准化患者参与下的客观结构化临床考试（OSCE）中，哪种教学方法能带来更好的访谈表现？2. 这两种方法如何影响学生的访谈自我效能？3. 学生如何评价这两种方法，他们更偏好哪种学习顺序？修读一门必修职业康复课程的学生被随机分配到两种顺序之一。在教学第一周，一种顺序练习访谈基于 GPT-4o 的模拟患者（一名35岁精神分裂症患者），另一种顺序观看并讨论同一病例的专家示范访谈。两组均在同一天完成9分钟标准化患者 OSCE。在接下来的一周，两种顺序交叉到另一种方法。访谈自我效能分别在教学前、第一种方法后和第二种方法后测量。

title: Interpretable Deep Learning Models for Breast Cancer Diagnosis Using Medical Imaging
zh_title: 乳腺癌病理图像的可解释深度学习诊断基准
summary: arXiv预印本在BreakHis病理数据集上按患者级划分比较十种ImageNet预训练模型，DenseNet121最佳（准确率99.4%），并用四种方法解释预测。
key_points: DenseNet121测试准确率99.4%、AUC 0.999，优于其他模型
Transformer类模型表现不及CNN

reason: 单一公开数据集、无外部验证，仅指标对比，属增量档。
abstract: Deep learning shows promise for breast cancer diagnosis, but limited interpretability hinders clinical adoption. We benchmark ten ImageNet-pretrained models (ResNet50, VGG19, InceptionV3, DenseNet121, Xception, MobileNetV2, EfficientNet, ConvNeXt, ViT, and Swin Transformer) for benign-versus-malignant classification on the BreakHis histopathology dataset using a patient-level split, and explain their predictions with Grad-CAM, LIME, Integrated Gradients, and LRP. DenseNet121 performed best, with 99.4% test accuracy and an AUC-ROC of 0.999, and significantly outperformed all other models (p < 0.001). Transformer-based models trailed the CNNs. The explanations consistently highlighted nuclei-rich and glandular regions of diagnostic relevance. Combining transfer learning with explainable AI can thus yield accurate, interpretable tools for breast cancer diagnosis.
zh_abstract: 深度学习在乳腺癌诊断中显示出前景，但可解释性有限阻碍了临床采用。我们在 BreakHis 组织病理学数据集上，使用患者级划分，对十个 ImageNet 预训练模型（ResNet50、VGG19、InceptionV3、DenseNet121、Xception、MobileNetV2、EfficientNet、ConvNeXt、ViT 和 Swin Transformer）进行良性与恶性分类基准测试，并用 Grad-CAM、LIME、Integrated Gradients 和 LRP 解释其预测。DenseNet121 表现最佳，测试准确率为 99.4%，AUC-ROC 为 0.999，并显著优于所有其他模型（p < 0.001）。基于 Transformer 的模型落后于 CNN。解释一致突出显示具有诊断相关性的富细胞核区域和腺体区域。因此，将迁移学习与可解释 AI 相结合，可产生用于乳腺癌诊断的准确、可解释工具。

title: The application value of artificial intelligence in medical imaging: foundations, progress, and challenges.
zh_title: AI在医学影像中的应用综述
summary: 综述梳理AI在影像工作流的角色与临床落地瓶颈，涉及泛化性、可解释性与责任归属。
key_points: 按影像工作流梳理AI功能定位
指出泛化性、可解释性不足
讨论临床责任归属不清
reason: 综述类且为2021年发表，内容偏概括，重要性有限。
abstract: [Medical review (2021)] Artificial intelligence (AI) is rapidly transforming medical imaging, reshaping the field as it does everyday life. As imaging data grow in complexity and clinical workloads continue to rise, AI has become increasingly essential for improving diagnostic efficiency and precision. However, despite these technical advances, the clinical adoption of AI in medical imaging remains fragmented, with limited generalizability, insufficient interpretability, and unclear clinical responsibility. In this review, we critically examine the evolution of AI in medical imaging, with a particular focus on its functional roles across the imaging workflow and its actual contributions to contemporary clinical needs. We systematically analyze current application paradigms, identify methodological and translational bottlenecks, and discuss emerging strategies to improve model robustness, interpretability, and clinical integration. In addition, we identify key barriers to the practical implementation of AI in medical imaging, including challenges related to cross-domain generalizability, data privacy issues and regulatory compliance. By examining these opportunities and challenges, this review aims to guide future research directions and foster deeper interdisciplinary collaboration among AI, clinical medicine, and biomedical engineering.
zh_abstract: 【医学综述（2021）】人工智能（AI）正在迅速改变医学影像，正如它改变日常生活一样重塑该领域。随着影像数据复杂性增加和临床工作量持续上升，AI在提高诊断效率和精确性方面变得越来越重要。然而，尽管有这些技术进步，AI在医学影像中的临床采用仍然碎片化，存在泛化能力有限、可解释性不足和临床责任不明确的问题。在这篇综述中，我们批判性地审视AI在医学影像中的演进，特别关注其在影像工作流程中的功能角色及其对当代临床需求的实际贡献。我们系统分析当前应用范式，识别方法和转化瓶颈，并讨论提高模型稳健性、可解释性和临床整合的新兴策略。此外，我们识别AI在医学影像中实际实施的关键障碍，包括跨域泛化能力、数据隐私问题和监管合规相关挑战。通过审视这些机遇与挑战，本综述旨在指导未来研究方向，并促进AI、临床医学和生物医学工程之间更深入的跨学科合作。

title: AntiOxiPred: Predicting Antioxidant Peptides using Machine Learning Techniques and BLAST
zh_title: AntiOxiPred：机器学习预测抗氧化肽
summary: 基于1511条实验验证抗氧化肽与1511条非抗氧化肽，构建结合BLAST与机器学习的预测方法。
key_points: 数据集含1511条实验验证抗氧化肽
训练集2417条、测试集606条
采用CatBoost与融合特征
reason: 小数据集预印本，仅内部测试，方法增量
abstract: Antioxidant peptides (AOPs) offer significant therapeutic potential in counteracting oxidative damage associated with chronic diseases. As AOPs gain market traction in cosmeceuticals, functional foods, and clinical trials for disease intervention, efficient computational methods are essential to accelerate their discovery. In this study, a systematic attempt has been made to develop a highly accurate and reliable method for predicting AOPs from their primary sequences. The dataset comprises 1,511 experimentally validated AOPs and 1,511 randomly generated non-AOPs, partitioned into 2,417 sequences for training and 606 for testing. First, we developed machine learning-based models using one-hot encoded (OHE) representations, sequence-derived compositional features, protein language model (PLM) embeddings, and feature fusion. Our CatBoost model, developed using selected fused features, achieved the best performance, with an AUC of 0.945 and an MCC of 0.788 on the independent testing dataset. An ensemble model combining CatBoost with BLAST achieved a peak AUC of 0.956 on the same testing dataset. Furthermore, our method outperformed existing state-of-the-art predictors when benchmarked on two external validation datasets comprising 150 peptides (75 AOPs and 75 non-AOPs) and 248 peptides (124 AOPs and 124 non-AOPs). AntiOxiPred (https://webs.iiitd.edu.in/raghava/antioxipred/) is freely available as an interactive web server, a standalone package, and a pip-installable tool to support the scientific community.
zh_abstract: 抗氧化肽（AOP）在对抗与慢性疾病相关的氧化损伤方面具有显著治疗潜力。随着 AOP 在药妆品、功能性食品和疾病干预临床试验中获得市场关注，高效计算方法对于加速其发现至关重要。本研究系统性地尝试开发一种高度准确且可靠的方法，从一级序列预测 AOP。数据集包含1,511个经实验验证的 AOP 和1,511个随机生成的非 AOP，其中2,417条序列用于训练，606条用于测试。首先，我们使用独热编码（OHE）表示、序列衍生的组成特征、蛋白质语言模型（PLM）嵌入和特征融合开发了基于机器学习的模型。我们使用选定融合特征开发的 CatBoost 模型表现最佳，在独立测试数据集上 AUC 为0.945，MCC 为0.788。将 CatBoost 与 BLAST 结合的集成模型在同一测试数据集上达到峰值 AUC 0.956。此外，在两个外部验证数据集（分别包含150条肽[75个 AOP 和75个非 AOP]和248条肽[124个 AOP 和124个非 AOP]）上进行基准测试时，我们的方法优于现有最先进预测器。AntiOxiPred（https://webs.iiitd.edu.in/raghava/antioxipred/）作为交互式网络服务器、独立软件包和可通过 pip 安装的工具免费提供，以支持科学界。

title: Predicting Protein-Protein Interactions Using Vectorized Sequence Descriptors and Machine Learning Classifiers
zh_title: 用向量化序列描述符与机器学习分类器预测蛋白质相互作用
summary: 预印本提出可解释机器学习框架，融合自协方差、联合三联与局部描述符特征，用SVM、随机森林和XGBoost预测蛋白质相互作用。
key_points: 融合120维AC、686维CT与1820维LD序列特征
采用分层五折交叉验证评估
报告交叉验证最高准确率97.97%
reason: 经典机器学习+仅交叉验证、无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Accurate prediction of protein-protein interactions (PPIs) is fundamental for elucidating cellular mechanisms and accelerating drug discovery. Although experimental techniques provide extensive interaction maps, their high cost and time requirements necessitate robust computational alternatives. In this study, we present an interpretable machine-learning framework that integrates sequence-derived descriptors, specifically 120 Auto-Covariance (AC) features, 686 Conjoint Triad (CT) features, and 1,820 Local Descriptors (LD) features, with classical classification algorithms, including Support Vector Machines (SVM), Random Forests (RF), and XGBoost (XGB). Evaluated on a gold-standard sequence-based PPI benchmark dataset using stratified five-fold cross-validation, the models achieved robust classification accuracies: 86.92% (SVM), 97.75% (RF), and a peak cross-validation accuracy of 97.97% with XGBoost (Rec: 98.09%, Pr: 98.10%, F1: 98.09%). Furthermore, rigorous evaluation on an independent unseen (Human-PPI) test set demonstrated exceptional generalization capabilities. The Random Forest model emerged as the top-performing architecture, yielding an outstanding accuracy of 99.51%, a precision of 99.72%, a recall of 99.29%, an F1-score of 99.50%, an Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.9990, and an Area Under the Precision-Recall Curve (AUPRC) of 0.9989 (closely followed by XGBoost with 98.54% accuracy, AUROC 0.9979, and AUPRC 0.9974). Feature-importance analysis revealed that short-range physicochemical correlations (such as polarity and hydrophobicity lags in Protein 2), regional amino-acid compositions, and specific triad patterns (e.g., A/G/V-M/S/T/YM/S/T/Y) drive accurate PPI discrimination. These findings demonstrate the effectiveness of domain-informed, handcrafted sequence features combined with machine-learning classifiers for PPI prediction, providing biologically interpretable insights with minimal computational overhead and enabling efficient, scalable interactome screening.
zh_abstract: 准确预测蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用（PPI）是阐明细胞机制和加速药物发现的基础。尽管实验技术提供了广泛的相互作用图谱，但其高成本和时间需求使得稳健的计算替代方法成为必要。在本研究中，我们提出一个可解释的机器学习框架，该框架将序列衍生描述符，具体为 120 个自协方差（AC）特征、686 个联合三元组（CT）特征和 1,820 个局部描述符（LD）特征，与经典分类算法整合，包括支持向量机（SVM）、随机森林（RF）和 XGBoost（XGB）。在基于序列的金标准 PPI 基准数据集上采用分层五折交叉验证进行评估，这些模型取得了稳健的分类准确率：86.92%（SVM）、97.75%（RF），XGBoost 达到峰值交叉验证准确率 97.97%（Rec：98.09%，Pr：98.10%，F1：98.09%）。此外，在一个独立的未见（Human-PPI）测试集上进行严格评估，显示出卓越的泛化能力。随机森林模型成为表现最佳的架构，取得出色的准确率 99.51%、精确率 99.72%、召回率 99.29%、F1 分数 99.50%、受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUROC）0.9990，以及精确率-召回率曲线下面积（AUPRC）0.9989（紧随其后的是 XGBoost，准确率 98.54%、AUROC 0.9979、AUPRC 0.9974）。特征重要性分析揭示，短程物理化学相关性（如 Protein 2 中的极性和疏水性滞后）、区域氨基酸组成以及特定三元组模式（例如 A/G/V-M/S/T/YM/S/T/Y）驱动了准确的 PPI 判别。这些发现证明了领域知识驱动的手工序列特征与机器学习分类器结合用于 PPI 预测的有效性，提供了具有生物学可解释性的见解，且计算开销极小，并能够实现高效、可扩展的相互作用组筛选。

title: Multicentre benchmark of PSMA PET/CT and mpMRI fusion for non-invasive clinically significant prostate cancer diagnosis
zh_title: PSMA PET/CT与mpMRI融合的多中心基准
summary: 三院527例配对影像，模型单中心开发、两中心外部验证，PSMA PET/CT增量价值最大。
key_points: 527例来自三家医院，含病理活检标签
363例开发，164例两外部中心独立评估
比较多种编码器、三种融合策略与跨模态Transformer
reason: 多中心外部验证+配对多模态真实世界数据，但样本数百例，属重要档偏下
abstract: Clinically significant prostate cancer (csPCa) guides-biopsy and treatment decisions, yet its non-invasive diagnosis remains challenging. The incremental value of PSMA PET/CT beyond multiparametric MRI (mpMRI), and the optimal strategy for multimodal fusion, remain unclear. We established a real-world, multicentre benchmark using 527 patients from three hospitals with fully paired PSMA PET, CT, T2-weighted MRI, and diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI), together with pathology-confirmed biopsy labels. Models were developed in one centre ( n = 363) and independently evaluated in two external centres ( n = 164). We compared frozen pretrained encoders, fine-tuned 2D and 3D CNN and Vision Transformer models, three fusion strategies, and an interpretable cross-modal Transformer. PSMA PET provided the greatest incremental value, with its removal producing the largest AUC reduction internally (−0.077) and externally (−0.055), supported by the highest attention attribution (αPET = 0.45). PSMA PET/CT also outperformed mpMRI externally (AUC 0.753 vs. 0.653). DWI was the principal source of domain shift, as its exclusion improved external AUC by 0.079 amid inter-centre b-value heterogeneity. Intermediate fusion performed most consistently internally, whereas late fusion and pretrained 2D models generalised better externally. This benchmark supports robust, non-invasive csPCa diagnosis by identifying modalities and fusion strategies that generalise reliably across institutions.
zh_abstract: 临床显著性前列腺癌（clinically significant prostate cancer, csPCa）指导活检和治疗决策，但其无创诊断仍具有挑战性。PSMA PET/CT相对于多参数MRI（multiparametric MRI, mpMRI）的增量价值，以及多模态融合的最佳策略，仍不清楚。我们建立了一个真实世界、多中心基准，使用来自三家医院的527例患者，具备完全配对的PSMA PET、CT、T2加权MRI和弥散加权成像（diffusion-weighted imaging, DWI），以及经病理确认的活检标签。模型在一个中心（n = 363）开发，并在两个外部中心（n = 164）独立评估。我们比较了冻结预训练编码器、微调的2D和3D CNN及Vision Transformer模型、三种融合策略，以及一个可解释的跨模态Transformer。PSMA PET提供了最大的增量价值，其移除在内部（−0.077）和外部（−0.055）产生最大的AUC下降，并得到最高注意力归因（αPET = 0.45）的支持。PSMA PET/CT在外部也优于mpMRI（AUC 0.753 vs. 0.653）。DWI是域偏移的主要来源，因为在其排除后，在中心间b值异质性的情况下，外部AUC提高了0.079。中间融合在内部表现最一致，而后期融合和预训练2D模型在外部泛化更好。该基准通过识别能够在不同机构间可靠泛化的模态和融合策略，支持稳健、无创的csPCa诊断。

title: Systemwide adoption patterns of ambient AI scribe technology in an integrated academic health system
zh_title: 大型学术医疗系统环境AI病历助手全员推广采用模式
summary: 回顾性观察研究分析2901名门诊医生在集成学术医疗系统内使用环境AI记录助手的采用率与就诊层面使用率差异。
key_points: 2901名门诊医生，2024年12月至2025年5月EHR与厂商使用数据
社区内科67%、社区儿科69%采用率最高，学术普外16%、妇产科18%最低

reason: 同行评审、企业级规模化部署真实采用数据，但为单系统回顾性观察，无临床结局
abstract: Ambient artificial intelligence (AI) scribes may reduce documentation burden, but little is known about their adoption during enterprise-scale ambulatory rollout. We conducted a retrospective observational cohort study of 2901 ambulatory clinicians at an integrated academic health system using linked electronic health record and vendor usage data from December 2024 through May 2025. Clinician adoption was defined as any use during the study period, and monthly visit-level uptake as the proportion of eligible ambulatory visits in which the ambient AI scribe was used. Adoption and uptake varied substantially across practice settings, specialties, and clinician types. Clinician-level adoption was highest in community internal medicine (67%), community general pediatrics (69%), and academic neurology (53%), and lowest in academic general surgery (16%), obstetrics and gynecology (18%), and psychiatry (19%). Community attending physicians and advanced practice providers showed marked increases in median visit-level uptake, reaching approximately 80%-90% in some groups by May 2025. Distinct longitudinal patterns included slow and steady adoption, early use followed by discontinuation, transient use, and late adoption. These findings suggest that implementation support and evaluation strategies should be tailored to local practice context rather than applied uniformly across a health system.
zh_abstract: 环境人工智能（ambient artificial intelligence, AI）记录员可能减轻文书负担，但对其在企业规模门诊推广中的采用情况知之甚少。我们开展了一项回顾性观察性队列研究，纳入某整合型学术医疗系统的2901名门诊临床医生，使用关联的电子健康记录和供应商使用数据，时间范围为2024年12月至2025年5月。临床医生采用定义为研究期间任何使用；月度就诊层面使用率定义为符合条件的门诊就诊中使用环境AI记录员的比例。采用情况和使用率在不同实践环境、专科和临床医生类型之间差异很大。临床医生层面采用率最高的是社区内科（67%）、社区普通儿科（69%）和学术神经科（53%），最低的是学术普通外科（16%）、妇产科（18%）和精神科（19%）。社区主治医师和高级实践提供者在就诊层面使用率中位数上显著增加，到2025年5月某些组达到约80%-90%。不同的纵向模式包括缓慢而稳定的采用、早期使用后停用、短暂使用和晚期采用。这些发现提示，实施支持和评估策略应根据当地实践背景量身定制，而不是在整个医疗系统中统一应用。

title: Visual-affective decoding enhances neurofunctional objective and generalizable signatures in unseen adolescent depression diagnosis
zh_title: 观影fMRI视觉-情感解码诊断青少年抑郁
summary: 200名青少年中，观影态fMRI视觉-情感解码模型区分抑郁与健康对照AUC 0.87，并外推至独立队列。
key_points: 200名青少年，含112例抑郁与88例对照
仅用健康对照训练的双通路异常检测
AUC 0.87，敏感度95.56%，外推独立队列
reason: 同行评审并有独立队列外推，但样本仅200、非临床结局，值得一看档
abstract: Adolescent major depressive disorder is a highly prevalent and debilitating condition, yet objective and generalizable neurofunctional signatures remain elusive. Existing neuroimaging approaches largely rely on resting-state fMRI, or controlled tasks often lack ecological validity and generalizable signatures of depression-related neural dysfunctions. This study proposes a Visual–Affective Decoding (VAD) framework integrating cross-subject visual and affective decoding from whole-brain fMRI acquired during naturalistic movie viewing. A dual-pathway anomaly detection model trained exclusively on healthy controls establishes normative brain function and identifies MDD through deviations from this norm. In 200 adolescents (112 MDD, 88 HC), VAD achieved an AUC of 0.87, 95.56% sensitivity, 83.89% accuracy, and 72.22% specificity. Using the same anomaly threshold, it generalized to an independent external adolescent cohort (70 MDD, 68 HC), achieving an AUC of 0.81 with an accuracy of 75.36%, supporting its cross-site generalizability. VAD further revealed interpretable neurofunctional signatures, including blunted emotional reactivity, attenuated visual representation, and affective patterns consistent with emotional rumination. Region-level contribution analyses identified dissociable visual- and affective-sensitive cortical regions, consistent with dysfunctions in visual, default-mode, salience, and higher-order associative networks. These findings demonstrate that VAD provides objective, interpretable, and generalizable neurofunctional signatures for adolescent depression diagnosis and clinically relevant biomarker development.
zh_abstract: 青少年重性抑郁障碍（MDD）是一种高度流行且致残的疾病，但客观且可泛化的神经功能特征仍难以获得。现有神经影像方法主要依赖静息态功能磁共振成像（fMRI），或受控任务往往缺乏生态效度和抑郁症相关神经功能障碍的可泛化特征。本研究提出一种视觉-情感解码（Visual–Affective Decoding, VAD）框架，整合来自自然观看电影期间采集的全脑fMRI的跨受试者视觉和情感解码。一个仅在健康对照者上训练的双通路异常检测模型建立规范性脑功能，并通过偏离该规范来识别MDD。在200名青少年（112例MDD，88例HC）中，VAD达到AUC为0.87、灵敏度95.56%、准确率83.89%和特异度72.22%。使用相同的异常阈值，它泛化到一个独立的外部青少年队列（70例MDD，68例HC），达到AUC为0.81、准确率75.36%，支持其跨站点泛化性。VAD进一步揭示了可解释的神经功能特征，包括情感反应迟钝、视觉表征减弱以及与情绪反刍一致的情感模式。区域水平贡献分析识别出可分离的视觉和情感敏感皮层区域，与视觉、默认模式、显著性和高级联合网络的功能障碍一致。这些发现表明，VAD为青少年抑郁症诊断和临床相关生物标志物开发提供了客观、可解释且可泛化的神经功能特征。

title: Masked Position Modeling as a Pre-Training Strategy for Foundational Deformable Image Registration Models.
source: PubMed · IEEE transactions on medical imaging
zh_title: 掩码位置建模预训练形变配准基础模型
summary: IEEE TMI 提出 MPM-Reg，用掩码位置建模实现模态无关的 Transformer 形变配准预训练范式。
key_points: 针对形变配准缺乏合适预训练方案的问题
MPM-Reg 为可迁移、模态无关的预训练策略
使纯 Transformer 模型可用于配准基础模型
reason: 同行评审的新预训练方法，但无外部验证与临床结局，属值得一看档
abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] The core objective of deformable image registration (DIR), estimating a displacement vector field that aligns two images, is fundamentally the same across imaging modalities and anatomical regions. Although this shared objective should imply the use of foundation models, most deep learning approaches for DIR operate within narrow domain-specific settings. Vision Transformers (ViTs) are the predominant choice for foundation models in many image processing tasks due to their excellent generalization capabilities and robustness to domain shifts. However, their use remains largely underexplored for DIR, which we attribute to a lack of suitable pre-training schemes. To address this need, we introduce MPM-Reg, a transferable, modality-agnostic training paradigm based on masked position modeling (MPM), enabling the use of fully transformer-based models as foundation models for image registration. Unlike conventional masked data modeling, which predicts the content of masked image patches, MPM masks the positional information and predicts the spatial relationship between image patches. Initially, we employ MPM on single images, which naturally aligns self-supervised pre-training of ViTs with the downstream registration task. Subsequently, we extend MPM to predict the positions of target patches within source images, re-formulating DIR through the lens of MPM. Experiments across eleven diverse datasets demonstrate MPM-Reg's competitive performance compared to state-of-the-art baselines. Crucially, MPM-Reg benefits from heterogeneous multi-domain data, which degrades the performance of existing methods, paving the way for scalable foundation models for DIR.
zh_abstract: [IEEE transactions on medical imaging] 可变形图像配准（deformable image registration, DIR）的核心目标是估计一个使两幅图像对齐的位移向量场，这一目标在不同成像模态和解剖区域之间本质上是相同的。尽管这一共同目标应意味着可以使用基础模型，但大多数用于DIR的深度学习方法仍在狭窄的特定领域设置中运行。视觉Transformer（Vision Transformers, ViTs）因其出色的泛化能力和对域偏移的鲁棒性，在许多图像处理任务中成为基础模型的主要选择。然而，它们在DIR中的应用仍很大程度上未被充分探索，我们将此归因于缺乏合适的预训练方案。为满足这一需求，我们提出MPM-Reg，一种基于掩码位置建模（masked position modeling, MPM）的可迁移、模态无关的训练范式，使完全基于Transformer的模型能够作为图像配准的基础模型。与传统掩码数据建模预测被掩码图像块的内容不同，MPM掩蔽位置信息并预测图像块之间的空间关系。首先，我们在单幅图像上采用MPM，这自然使ViTs的自监督预训练与下游配准任务相一致。随后，我们将MPM扩展到预测源图像中目标图像块的位置，通过MPM的视角重新表述DIR。在十一个多样化数据集上的实验表明，MPM-Reg与最先进的基线相比具有竞争力。关键的是，MPM-Reg受益于异构多域数据，而这种数据会降低现有方法的性能，为可扩展的DIR基础模型铺平道路。

title: GliaDose: An alternative approach for clinical CAR-T dose prediction via PBPK–glioblastoma-on-a-chip integration
zh_title: GliaDose：PBPK与胶质瘤芯片联用的CAR-T剂量预测
summary: 提出整合PBPK模型与血管化胶质母细胞瘤器官芯片的混合框架，用于CAR-T首次人体剂量预测。
key_points: CAR-T具非线性药代动力学，动物到人体外推不可靠
PBPK模型仅用人源生理数据参数化
与胶质瘤-on-a-chip平台结合进行定量剂量预测
reason: 同行评审新方法预印框架，但未见临床验证或外部队列，属值得一看档
abstract: Glioblastoma (GBM) is a highly aggressive brain tumor with poor prognosis and limited treatment options. Chimeric antigen receptor T cell (CAR-T) therapy has emerged as a promising immunotherapy for GBM. However, unlike conventional drugs, CAR-T cells are living therapeutics that exhibit non-linear pharmacokinetics, expansion, and complex tissue trafficking, making conventional animal-to-human dose extrapolation unreliable. Furthermore, species-specific differences and the vasculature limit the translational relevance of preclinical models. To address these challenges, we developed GliaDose, a hybrid framework that integrates physiologically based pharmacokinetic (PBPK) modeling with a vascularized glioblastoma-on-a-chip (GoC) platform to support quantitative first-in-human dose (FIHD) prediction for CAR-T therapy. The PBPK model was parameterized exclusively with human physiological data and incorporates a brain-tumor compartment to explicitly capture CAR-T transport across the vasculature. Complementarily, the GoC platform recapitulates key features of the GBM microenvironment, including three-dimensional tumor architecture, extracellular matrix, and perfusable human vascular networks, enabling assessment of CAR-T transmigration under flow conditions. Integration of GoC-derived efficacy data into the PBPK framework enabled quantitative dose–response predictions and identified vascular barriers as critical determinants of CAR-T tumor access. GliaDose provides a human-relevant, mechanistic alternative to animal-based dose selection and may improve FIHD prediction and personalized CAR-T therapy for GBM.
zh_abstract: 胶质母细胞瘤（GBM）是一种高度侵袭性的脑肿瘤，预后差且治疗选择有限。嵌合抗原受体 T 细胞（CAR-T）疗法已成为 GBM 一种有前景的免疫疗法。然而，与传统药物不同，CAR-T 细胞是活体治疗产品，表现出非线性药代动力学、扩增和复杂的组织转运，使传统的动物到人体剂量外推不可靠。此外，物种特异性差异和血管系统限制了临床前模型的转化相关性。为应对这些挑战，我们开发了 GliaDose，这是一种混合框架，将基于生理学的药代动力学（PBPK）建模与血管化胶质母细胞瘤芯片（GoC）平台相结合，以支持 CAR-T 疗法的定量首次人体剂量（FIHD）预测。该 PBPK 模型仅使用人体生理数据进行参数化，并纳入脑肿瘤隔室，以明确捕捉 CAR-T 跨血管的转运。作为补充，GoC 平台重现了 GBM 微环境的关键特征，包括三维肿瘤结构、细胞外基质和可灌注的人血管网络，从而能够在流动条件下评估 CAR-T 的跨内皮迁移。将 GoC 衍生的疗效数据整合到 PBPK 框架中，实现了定量剂量–反应预测，并确定血管屏障是 CAR-T 进入肿瘤的关键决定因素。GliaDose 提供了一种与人体相关、基于机制的替代方案，可替代基于动物的剂量选择，并可能改善 GBM 的 FIHD 预测和个体化 CAR-T 治疗。

title: Artificial intelligence in acute stroke imaging: A comprehensive survey from imaging assessment to outcome prediction.
source: PubMed · Computerized medical imaging and graphics : the official journal of the Computerized Medical Imaging Society
zh_title: 急性卒中影像AI综述：从影像评估到预后预测
summary: PRISMA式检索综述84篇同行评审文献，比较缺血性卒中与脑出血影像深度学习流程的任务差异与共同框架缺失。
key_points: 覆盖84篇文献，采用PRISMA规范检索
脑出血以CT为主，聚焦出血识别与分型
指出两类卒中技术差异未被统一框架考察
reason: 系统综述纳入84篇研究、结论明确，按综述档上限给6分
abstract: [Computerized medical imaging and graphics : the official journal of the Computerized Medical Imaging Society] Acute strokes encompass two main types: acute ischemic stroke (AIS) and intracerebral hemorrhage (ICH). Each type involves specific imaging techniques and entails different clinical considerations. While deep learning has facilitated the analysis of stroke imaging autonomously, the technical differences between these two stroke types have not been examined within a shared analytical framework. This review addresses that gap through the examination of 84 peer-reviewed articles. A PRISMA-compliant search was conducted using multiple databases. Analysis of the ICH pipeline predominantly uses CT imaging and is primarily centered on a classification task. The main focus is on hemorrhage identification, subtype classification, hematoma expansion prediction, and forecasting associated clinical outcomes. The AIS pipeline is primarily based on quantification and therefore uses a variety of imaging techniques to optimize and automate the analysis of a specific set of clinical questions related to the stroke. Core tasks include segmentation of the infarct area, assessment scoring, large vessel occlusion, core-penumbra mismatch analysis, and prediction of outcomes. Convergence is also observed in outcome prediction approaches across both domains. Existing models demonstrate clinically acceptable performance across numerous tasks. Clinical deployment nonetheless remains limited by the lack of external validation, high costs of annotation, demands of real-time processing, and poor prospective evidence. This review offers practical guidance to develop fully operational AI systems that can be integrated into emergency stroke care.
zh_abstract: [《计算机化医学成像与图形》（Computerized Medical Imaging and Graphics）：计算机化医学成像学会（Computerized Medical Imaging Society）官方期刊] 急性卒中包括两种主要类型：急性缺血性卒中（AIS）和脑出血（ICH）。每种类型涉及特定影像技术，并带来不同的临床考量。尽管深度学习已促进卒中影像的自主分析，但这两类卒中的技术差异尚未在共享分析框架内得到考察。本综述通过考察 84 篇同行评议文章来填补这一空白。使用多个数据库进行了符合 PRISMA 的检索。对 ICH 流程的分析主要使用 CT 成像，且主要集中于分类任务。主要关注点包括出血识别、亚型分类、血肿扩大预测以及预测相关临床结局。AIS 流程主要基于定量分析，因此使用多种影像技术来优化和自动化分析与卒中相关的一组特定临床问题。核心任务包括梗死区分割、评估评分、大血管闭塞、核心-缺血半暗带不匹配分析以及结局预测。在两个领域的结果预测方法中也观察到趋同。现有模型在众多任务中表现出临床可接受的性能。然而，临床部署仍受限于缺乏外部验证、标注成本高、实时处理需求以及前瞻性证据不足。本综述为开发可整合到急诊卒中救治中的完全可运行 AI 系统提供实用指导。

title: Auditing evaluation artifacts and data leakage in large language model systems for rare disease diagnosis
zh_title: 罕见病诊断大模型评测泄漏审计
summary: 审计6万余例罕见病病例，指出候选空间污染会虚高多模态大模型（LLM）的诊断表现，严格跨数据集隔离后Recall@1明显下降。
key_points: 6万余例来自公开与独立临床队列
候选集污染人为抬高诊断表现
跨数据集隔离后Recall@1由54.3%下降
reason: 6万例级多队列实证审计，量化数据泄漏影响，属重要档
abstract: Augmented large language model (LLM) systems have reported high benchmark accuracies in rare disease diagnosis, yet their real-world clinical utility remains unproven. A recent meta-analysis flagged augmented LLM diagnostic evaluations as having a high risk of bias due to suspected data leakage; however, the precise impact of these vulnerabilities on model inference has yet to be fully quantified. In this study, we present a comprehensive empirical audit to quantify evaluation artifacts across prevailing AI paradigms, using a repository of over 60,000 cases from diverse public and independent clinical cohorts. By reconstructing a state-of-the-art agentic framework, we demonstrate that candidate-space contamination artificially inflates performance: enforcing strict cross-dataset isolation resulted in a marked performance decline, with the cross-dataset mean Recall@1 decreasing from 54.3% (under conventional one-vs-rest evaluation) to 40.3% (Hedges' g = 0.94). Similar spatial overfitting in supervised classifiers caused diagnostic accuracy to drop from an internal mean of 42.9% to 16.7% across external cohorts (Cohen's d = 2.01). Furthermore, we quantify how LLMs infer diagnoses by exploiting retrospective therapeutic cues in clinical narratives, and how temporal misalignment in foundational knowledge bases leads to performance fluctuations. We conclude that prevailing evaluation protocols for augmented LLM systems inadvertently reflect data leakage rather than genuine medical reasoning. To address these systematic artifacts, we propose a rigorous evaluation framework - coupling strict data-isolation protocols with standardized benchmarking safeguards - to ensure future diagnostic AI for rare diseases is evaluated on actual clinical robustness.
zh_abstract: 增强型大语言模型（large language model, LLM）系统在罕见病诊断中报告了高基准准确率，但其真实世界临床效用仍未得到证实。最近一项荟萃分析将增强型LLM诊断评估标记为因疑似数据泄漏而具有高偏倚风险；然而，这些漏洞对模型推理的确切影响尚未完全量化。在本研究中，我们开展全面的实证审计，以量化主流AI范式中的评估伪影，使用来自多样公共和独立临床队列的超过60,000例病例库。通过重建最先进的智能体框架，我们证明候选空间污染人为夸大了性能：强制执行严格的跨数据集隔离导致性能显著下降，跨数据集平均Recall@1从54.3%（在传统一对其余（one-vs-rest）评估下）降至40.3%（Hedges' g = 0.94）。监督分类器中类似的空间过拟合导致诊断准确率从内部平均42.9%降至外部队列的16.7%（Cohen's d = 2.01）。此外，我们量化了LLM如何通过利用临床叙述中的回顾性治疗线索推断诊断，以及基础知识库中的时间错配如何导致性能波动。我们得出结论，增强型LLM系统的主流评估方案无意中反映的是数据泄漏，而非真正的医学推理。为处理这些系统性伪影，我们提出严谨的评估框架——将严格数据隔离方案与标准化基准测试保障措施相结合——以确保未来罕见病诊断AI基于真实临床稳健性接受评估。

title: Multimodal Generative AI Assists Comprehensive Echocardiographic Interpretation
zh_title: EchoChat：多模态生成式AI辅助超声心动图综合判读
summary: 基于46358例检查训练的超声心动图视觉语言模型，在六个国际队列取得新的最优表现。
key_points: 构建EchoChat多模态生成式视觉语言模型
训练集含46358例超声心动图指令对
六个国际队列验证并给出思维链依据
reason: 多国际队列外部验证且样本超4.6万，预印本取7分上限档。
abstract: Echocardiography is the cornerstone of cardiovascular diagnostics, yet its global utility is constrained by a critical shortage of experienced interpreters. Current artificial intelligence (AI) solutions remain limited, typically operating as opaque "black boxes" or focusing on narrow tasks that fail to capture the holistic, guideline-driven reasoning of a clinician. Here we introduce EchoChat, a generative multimodal vision-language model that performs comprehensive echocardiographic analysis to support clinician interpretation. By emulating the cognitive workflow of a cardiologist, EchoChat integrates vast medical knowledge with a chain-of-thought reasoning mechanism to explicitly ground its conclusions in visual evidence. Trained on echocardiography-instruction pairs from 46,358 examinations, our model establishes a new state-of-the-art across diverse cohorts from six international medical centers. It supports the broadest diagnostic scope of 33 cardiac conditions and findings, including 15 newly added conditions for which it achieves an average F1 of 73.7% across available external evaluations. It surpasses existing best-performing foundation models in cardiac condition recognition (improving average recall by 13.54% on shared tasks) and quantification (average R2 score increase of 0.275 on shared tasks). Furthermore, in a source-blinded echocardiographer reader study, echocardiography reports co-generated with EchoChat were rated higher in diagnostic accuracy and completeness by two senior echocardiographers, and improved diagnostic performance from 72.78% to 82.75% in terms of F1 score over routine-reader only reports. These results demonstrate that integrating clinical reasoning into multimodal AI can democratize specialist expertise and transform the standard of cardiovascular care.
zh_abstract: 超声心动图是心血管诊断的基石，但其全球应用受限于经验丰富的判读者严重短缺。当前的人工智能（AI）解决方案仍然有限，通常作为不透明的“黑箱”运行，或聚焦于狭窄任务，未能捕捉临床医生整体性、指南驱动的推理过程。在此，我们介绍 EchoChat，一种生成式多模态视觉-语言模型，可执行全面的超声心动图分析以支持临床医生判读。通过模拟心脏病学家的认知工作流程，EchoChat 将广泛的医学知识与思维链推理机制相结合，使其结论明确建立在视觉证据之上。该模型在来自 46,358 次检查的超声心动图-指令对上进行训练，在来自六个国际医学中心的多样队列中建立了新的最先进水平。它支持最广泛的诊断范围，涵盖 33 种心脏状况和发现，其中包括 15 种新增状况；在可获得的外部评估中，其对这些新增状况的平均 F1 达到 73.7%。它在心脏状况识别（在共享任务上平均召回率提高 13.54%）和量化（在共享任务上平均 R2 评分提高 0.275）方面超越了现有表现最佳的基础模型。此外，在一项来源盲法的超声心动图医师阅片研究中，由两名资深超声心动图医师评定，与 EchoChat 共同生成的超声心动图报告在诊断准确性和完整性方面评分更高，并且相较于仅由常规读片者生成的报告，其诊断性能按 F1 评分从 72.78% 提高到 82.75%。这些结果表明，将临床推理整合到多模态 AI 中可使专科知识普及化，并转变心血管照护的标准。

title: U-NeXt: General-purpose event detection for neonatal EEG
zh_title: U-NeXt：新生儿脑电事件检测通用框架
summary: 提出基于语义分割的U-NeXt框架，统一检测新生儿脑电低电压段、伪差与癫痫发作，并在两个独立外部数据集验证。
key_points: 训练集含51/98/278名新生儿，逾1.1万小时脑电
82,000条标注事件，与任务专用ConvNeXt分类器对比
在Helsinki与Cork两个独立留出集（130名新生儿）外部验证
reason: 大样本多任务训练并有两个独立外部数据集验证，达重要档；预印本不高于8
abstract: We developed U-NeXt, a general framework for neonatal electroencephalography (EEG) event detection based on semantic segmentation. Its convolutional encoder-decoder directly segments individual channels using long input segments to preserve temporal context. A shared architecture and training framework were developed using low-voltage interval, artefact, and seizure datasets containing 51, 98, and 278 neonates, respectively, comprising over 11,000 hours of EEG and 82,000 annotated events. Performance was compared with task-specific ConvNeXt classifiers. For seizure detection, we also evaluated U-NeXt+, trained on an expanded dataset. Both U-NeXt variants and the ConvNeXt baseline were evaluated on two independent held-out seizure datasets, Helsinki and Cork, comprising 130 neonates, with recordings annotated by three experts. U-NeXt improved detection across all three event types, with particular gains in sensitivity for short events. U-NeXt+ achieved Matthews correlation coefficients of 0.862 and 0.891 on Helsinki and Cork, respectively, and improved hourly seizure burden correlations by 30-40% relative to ConvNeXt. U-NeXt+ met the criterion for expert-level performance on both datasets (p < 0.001). In separate computational benchmarks, U-NeXt reduced batch inference time relative to ConvNeXt by 254-fold on a central processing unit and 200-fold on a graphics processing unit. A common segmentation framework improves detection across diverse neonatal EEG event types while substantially reducing inference time. Accurate seizure burden estimates and performance comparable to expert reviewers support its potential use in continuous monitoring and clinical decision support.
zh_abstract: 我们开发了U-NeXt，一种基于语义分割的新生儿脑电图（EEG）事件检测通用框架。其卷积编码器-解码器使用长输入片段直接分割单个通道，以保留时间背景。使用分别包含51、98和278名新生儿的低电压间期、伪差和癫痫发作数据集，开发了共享架构和训练框架，包括超过11,000小时的EEG和82,000个标注事件。性能与任务特定的ConvNeXt分类器进行比较。对于癫痫发作检测，我们还评估了在扩展数据集上训练的U-NeXt+。两种U-NeXt变体和ConvNeXt基线均在两个独立的留出癫痫发作数据集Helsinki和Cork上评估，包含130名新生儿，记录由三位专家标注。U-NeXt改善了所有三种事件类型的检测，在短事件灵敏度方面尤其有提升。U-NeXt+在Helsinki和Cork上分别达到0.862和0.891的Matthews相关系数，并且相对于ConvNeXt，每小时癫痫负荷相关性提高30-40%。U-NeXt+在两个数据集上均达到专家级性能标准（p < 0.001）。在单独的计算基准测试中，U-NeXt相对于ConvNeXt将批量推理时间在中央处理单元上减少254倍，在图形处理单元上减少200倍。一个通用的分割框架改善了多种新生儿EEG事件类型的检测，同时大幅减少推理时间。准确的癫痫负荷估计和与专家审阅者相当的性能支持其在连续监测和临床决策支持中的潜在用途。

Diagnostic delay, cancer stage, treatment opportunity, complications, and longer-term cancer outcomes are also assessed.

title: scMAC: large language model-enhanced single-cell functional priors for completing functional context in bulk T cell receptor repertoires.
zh_title: scMAC：大模型增强单细胞先验补全TCR功能
summary: 同行评审研究提出scMAC框架，用单细胞功能先验为bulk TCR repertoire补全T细胞功能状态。
key_points: 用配对单细胞RNA/TCR构建功能先验
去噪并处理TCR与转录组间概率关系
将先验迁移至bulk TCR repertoire推断功能组成
reason: 同行评审新方法，思路清晰但条目未显示外部验证或大规模评测
abstract: [Briefings in bioinformatics] Bulk T cell receptor (TCR) sequencing enables scalable immune repertoire profiling but does not measure the transcriptional states required to infer T cell functional programs. Paired single-cell RNA/TCR sequencing offers a single-cell functional prior by jointly observing TCR identity and transcriptomic states. However, transferring this prior to bulk repertoires is challenging: sparse and noisy single-cell profiles can distort the functional reference, and the probabilistic relationship between TCR identity and transcriptome-inferred functional state makes direct cell-level alignment unstable, potentially biasing repertoire-level functional composition estimation. We present scMAC, a single-cell-guided framework for functional context completion that infers TCR functional representations reflecting transcriptome-derived T-cell states. scMAC builds a denoised functional reference by integrating multi-scale expression modeling with gene-semantic priors derived from large language model encodings of gene and protein descriptions, improving gene-level functional coherence. It then learns a prototype-guided TCR-to-function mapping that combines paired cell-level latent alignment with functional prototype regularization, enabling robust repertoire-level functional composition estimation. Across real single-cell and paired RNA/TCR datasets, scMAC outperformed existing single-cell representation methods in fine-grained cell-state representation, gene functional consistency, expression recovery, and disease-relevant pathway analysis, achieving an adjusted Rand index of 0.656 on a colorectal cancer dataset with 83 cell subtypes. For repertoire-level functional composition estimation, scMAC closely matched single-cell-derived functional proportions, with an R2 of 0.979 and a Bray-Curtis distance of 0.075. These results support scMAC as a practical route for transferring single-cell-derived functional knowledge to bulk TCR repertoire analysis beyond clonotype identity and clonal abundance. scMAC is publicly available at https://github.com/Bioinformatics7181/scMAC.
zh_abstract: [Briefings in bioinformatics] 批量 T 细胞受体（TCR）测序可实现可扩展的免疫组库分析，但无法测量推断 T 细胞功能程序所需的转录状态。配对的单细胞 RNA/TCR 测序通过联合观察 TCR 身份和转录组状态，提供单细胞功能先验。然而，将该先验迁移到批量组库具有挑战性：稀疏且嘈杂的单细胞图谱可能扭曲功能参考，而 TCR 身份与转录组推断的功能状态之间的概率关系使直接的细胞水平对齐不稳定，可能使组库水平的功能组成估计产生偏差。我们提出 scMAC，一种单细胞引导的功能背景补全框架，可推断反映转录组衍生 T 细胞状态的 TCR 功能表征。scMAC 通过整合多尺度表达建模与源自基因和蛋白质描述的大语言模型编码的基因语义先验，构建去噪的功能参考，从而提高基因水平的功能一致性。然后，它学习一种原型引导的 TCR 到功能映射，将配对的细胞水平潜在对齐与功能原型正则化相结合，从而实现稳健的组库水平功能组成估计。在真实单细胞和配对 RNA/TCR 数据集中，scMAC 在细粒度细胞状态表征、基因功能一致性、表达恢复和疾病相关通路分析方面优于现有单细胞表征方法，在一个具有 83 种细胞亚型的结直肠癌数据集上达到调整兰德指数 0.656。对于组库水平功能组成估计，scMAC 与单细胞衍生的功能比例高度匹配，R2 为 0.979，Bray-Curtis 距离为 0.075。这些结果支持 scMAC 作为将单细胞衍生的功能知识迁移到批量 TCR 组库分析（超越克隆型身份和克隆丰度）的实用途径。scMAC 公开可用，网址为 https://github.com/Bioinformatics7181/scMAC。

abstract: [European journal of obstetrics, gynecology, and reproductive biology] Embryo selection is one of the most critical determinants of success in in vitro fertilization (IVF). Conventional approaches based on static morphological grading and time-lapse imaging (TLI) remain subjective and show only modest predictive accuracy. Artificial intelligence (AI) tools, including deep learning-based platforms such as iDAScore and KIDScore, have emerged as potentially more standardized alternatives, yet their true clinical impact on per-transfer outcomes remains uncertain. To determine whether AI-assisted embryo selection offers measurable clinical advantages over conventional morphology-based methods in IVF. A systematic review and meta-analysis was conducted by searching four electronic databases (PubMed, Scopus, Embase, and the Cochrane Library) from January 2013 to April 2024. Randomized controlled trials (RCTs) and observational cohort studies evaluating AI-assisted embryo selection versus conventional morphology in IVF cycles without preimplantation genetic testing for aneuploidy (PGT-A), reporting at least one of clinical pregnancy rate (CPR), implantation rate (IR), or live birth rate (LBR). Two reviewers independently screened records and extracted data. Study quality was assessed using the Cochrane Risk of Bias 2 tool for the RCT and the Newcastle-Ottawa Scale for observational studies. Where arm-level data were available, risk ratios (RR) with 95% confidence intervals (CI) were pooled using a random-effects model. Ten studies were included. Only two reported arm-level outcomes suitable for meta-analysis. The pooled estimate showed no significant difference in clinical pregnancy rate between AI-assisted and morphology-based selection (RR = 0.99, 95% CI 0.87-1.12; I2 = 26.5%), with no statistically significant difference between the two methods. The remaining eight studies reported predictive performance metrics with area under the receiver operating characteristic curve values of 0.85-0.96, though these did not consistently translate into improved per-cycle outcomes. Implantation and live birth rates were inconsistently reported and could not be pooled. AI-based embryo scoring showed no statistically significant difference compared with conventional morphology for per-transfer clinical pregnancy rate, with potential advantages in standardization and inter-observer consistency. zh_abstract: [欧洲妇产科与生殖生物学杂志] 胚胎选择是体外受精（IVF）成功的最关键决定因素之一。基于静态形态学分级和延时成像（TLI）的传统方法仍然具有主观性，并且仅显示出中等程度的预测准确性。人工智能（AI）工具，包括基于深度学习的平台如iDAScore和KIDScore，已成为可能更标准化的替代方案，但其对每次移植结局的真实临床影响仍不确定。确定AI辅助胚胎选择在IVF中是否比传统基于形态学的方法提供可测量的临床优势。通过检索四个电子数据库（PubMed、Scopus、Embase和Cochrane Library），从2013年1月至2024年4月，进行了一项系统综述和荟萃分析。纳入评估AI辅助胚胎选择与传统形态学选择在未进行胚胎植入前非整倍体遗传学检测（PGT-A）的IVF周期中的随机对照试验（RCT）和观察性队列研究，并报告临床妊娠率（CPR）、着床率（IR）或活产率（LBR）中至少一项。两名评审员独立筛选记录并提取数据。研究质量分别使用Cochrane偏倚风险2工具评估RCT，使用纽卡斯尔-渥太华量表评估观察性研究。在可获得研究臂水平数据时，使用随机效应模型合并风险比（RR）及其95%置信区间（CI）。共纳入10项研究。仅有两项报告了适合荟萃分析的研究臂水平结局。合并估计显示，AI辅助选择与基于形态学选择的临床妊娠率无显著差异（RR = 0.99，95% CI 0.87-1.12；I2 = 26.5%），两种方法之间无统计学显著差异。其余八项研究报告了预测性能指标，受试者工作特征曲线下面积值为0.85-0.96，尽管这些并未一致转化为每周期结局的改善。着床率和活产率的报告不一致，无法合并。基于AI的胚胎评分与常规形态学相比，在每次移植的临床妊娠率方面未显示出统计学显著差异，在标准化和观察者间一致性方面具有潜在优势。然而，优效性仍未得到证实，关键以患者为中心的结局，包括累积活产率、流产率和从开始尝试到妊娠的时间（time-to-pregnancy）we
