abstract: [Nursing reports (Pavia, Italy)] Background/Objectives: Artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly integrated into clinical gastroenterology, with emerging applications in nursing contexts. However, the extent and nature of these applications in gastroenterology nursing remain under-explored. This scoping review aimed to map the current landscape of AI and closely related AI-adjacent digital technologies in gastroenterology nursing. Methods: Following the Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses extension for Scoping Reviews (PRISMA-ScR) guideline, PubMed, Medline, Web of Science, and Scopus were searched for peer-reviewed, English-language studies published since 2000, and the findings were synthesized narratively. Results: Of 184 records identified, 11 studies were included, highlighting the potential of these technologies in clinical decision support, workflow optimization, patient education, and endoscopy assistance. Reported benefits include gains in workflow efficiency, technical accuracy, and reduced administrative workload; direct evidence of improved nursing-led patient outcomes was reported in only a minority of studies. Challenges encompass limited nurse-led research, insufficient external validation, implementation gaps, and ethical concerns. Conclusions: Greater nurse involvement in AI development is essential to drive paradigm shifts in clinical practice. This review synthesizes evidence to inform future applications, research, and policy in AI-enhanced gastroenterology nursing.
zh_abstract: [Nursing Reports (Pavia, Italy)] 【背景/目的】人工智能（AI）正日益融入临床胃肠病学，并在护理情境中出现新兴应用。然而，这些应用在胃肠病学护理中的范围和性质仍探索不足。本范围综述旨在描绘 AI 及密切相关的 AI 邻近数字技术在胃肠病学护理中的当前图景。【方法】遵循系统综述和荟萃分析优先报告条目范围综述扩展版（PRISMA-ScR）指南，检索 PubMed、Medline、Web of Science 和 Scopus 中自 2000 年以来发表的同行评审英文研究，并对结果进行叙述性综合。【结果】在识别出的 184 条记录中，纳入了 11 项研究，突显了这些技术在临床决策支持、工作流程优化、患者教育和内镜辅助方面的潜力。报告的优势包括工作流程效率、技术准确性和行政工作量减少方面的改善；仅少数研究报告了护理主导的患者结局改善的直接证据。挑战包括护理主导研究有限、外部验证不足、实施差距和伦理问题。【结论】护士更多参与 AI 开发对于推动临床实践范式转变至关重要。本综述综合证据，为 AI 增强的胃肠病学护理的未来应用、研究和政策提供信息。

title: Mathematical AI Predicts 40% and 57% Influenza Vaccine Effectiveness Against H1N1 and H3N2, Respectively, for the 2026--2027 U.S. Season
zh_title: 数学模型预测2026–27美国流感季疫苗有效性
summary: 预印本：基于HA蛋白氨基酸距离的模型预测H1N1与H3N2疫苗有效性分别约40%和57%。
key_points: 用GISAID的HA序列计算与疫苗株的氨基酸距离
与13个流感季共26个已发表VE观测值配对
给出2026–27季的季前VE预测值
reason: 仅26个观测的季前预测建模，预印本且无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Background: Clinical influenza vaccine effectiveness (VE) has often been low over the past two decades, highlighting the need for preseason VE forecasting. Timely forecasts could help health authorities plan prevention strategies and allocate healthcare resources. However, preseason forecasting of clinical influenza VE remains relatively uncommon. Methods: We obtained hemagglutinin (HA) sequences from GISAID for U.S. specimens collected in August--September before each influenza season from 2010--2011 through 2024--2025. After quality screening, we compared each virus with the corresponding vaccine target strain for the same season and subtype or lineage using two mathematical distances based on amino acid patterns in the HA protein. We calculated mean distances for each season and subtype or lineage and paired them with published clinical VE estimates, yielding 26 observations across 13 seasons. Using a mathematical AI approach, we fitted linear regression models of VE against each distance and evaluated their predictive performance by forecasting later seasons using data from earlier seasons, with the historical mean VE for each subtype or lineage as a reference. We then applied the same approach to 87 HA sequences collected in August--September 2026 to forecast VE for the 2026--2027 season. Results: We generated component-specific forecasts of influenza VE for the upcoming 2026--2027 U.S. season. Both mathematical distances were negatively associated with historical VE, indicating that greater differences between circulating viruses and vaccine strains were associated with lower VE. The topological model forecast VE of 40.3%, 56.9%, and 47.1% against A(H1N1)pdm09, A(H3N2), and B/Victoria, respectively, whereas the geometric model forecast corresponding VE values of 34.0%, 56.8%, and 51.1%.
zh_abstract: 【背景】过去二十年中，临床流感疫苗有效性（VE）常常较低，这凸显了进行季前 VE 预测的必要性。及时预测可帮助卫生主管部门规划预防策略并分配医疗资源。然而，临床流感 VE 的季前预测仍相对少见。【方法】我们获取了 GISAID 中美国标本的 HA 序列，这些标本采集于 2010—2011 至 2024—2025 每个流感季节前的 8—9 月。经过质量筛查后，我们使用基于 HA 蛋白氨基酸模式的两种数学距离，将每种病毒与同一季节及同一亚型或谱系的相应疫苗靶标株进行比较。我们计算每个季节及亚型或谱系的平均距离，并将其与已发表的临床 VE 估计值配对，从而在 13 个季节中获得 26 个观测值。使用一种数学 AI 方法，我们拟合了 VE 对每种距离的线性回归模型，并通过使用较早季节数据预测较晚季节来评估其预测性能，同时以每个亚型或谱系的历史平均 VE 作为参考。随后，我们将相同方法应用于 2026 年 8—9 月采集的 87 条 HA 序列，以预测 2026—2027 季节的 VE。【结果】我们生成了针对即将到来的 2026—2027 美国季节的流感 VE 组分特异性预测。两种数学距离均与历史 VE 呈负相关，表明流行病毒与疫苗株之间差异越大，VE 越低。拓扑模型预测对 A(H1N1)pdm09、A(H3N2) 和 B/Victoria 的 VE 分别为 40.3%、56.9% 和 47.1%，而几何模型预测的相应 VE 值分别为 34.0%、56.8% 和 51.1%。

title: Development and Validation of an Automated Image-Based Method for Prognostic Stratification in Lung Adenocarcinoma using Immunohistochemical Markers
zh_title: 开源IHC图像自动量化用于肺腺癌预后分层
summary: 预印本：提出基于IHC图像的MEL评分替代人工H评分，并在128例肺腺癌中评估。
key_points: 整合组织区域分割与肿瘤面积加权标志物定量
归一化处理样本与批次间染色差异
以Fiji/ImageJ开源工具发布，仅128例单中心
reason: 小样本单中心预印本，无外部验证，但方法开源属增量偏上
abstract: We present an automated image-based framework for quantifying biomarker expression in immunohistochemical (IHC) images and introduce the Marker Expression Level (MEL) score as an objective alternative to visual H-scoring. MEL addresses key limitations of existing automated methods by integrating tissue-region segmentation with tumour-area-weighted marker quantification, normalization to mitigate inter-sample and inter-batch staining variability, and robust quantification of nuclear, cytoplasmic, and membrane-associated biomarkers. The complete pipeline was developed as an open-source Fiji/ImageJ tool and is publicly available. We evaluated MEL using IHC images from 128 lung adenocarcinoma patients stained for BRCA1, GLUT1, and QKI, three markers forming a prognostic signature previously described by our group. Tissue regions were segmented using a machine learning-based Fiji plugin, and MEL scores were calculated within tumour regions. A normalization strategy accounted for inter-TMA staining variability. Agreement with visual H-scores was assessed using Spearman correlation. Prognostic performance was evaluated using Cox regression to derive a Combined Prognostic Index (CPI) incorporating MEL scores and tumour stage. Segmentation achieved high accuracy across tissue regions (Dice coefficients 0.69-0.99), with lower performance in highly immune-infiltrated stromal areas. MEL scores significantly correlated with visual H-scores for all markers ({rho} = 0.61-0.69, p < 0.001). Normalization improved agreement for GLUT1 ({rho} = 0.39 to 0.62). The derived CPI stratified patients into distinct risk groups with significant differences in disease-free and overall survival (p < 0.05), comparable to visual scoring. MEL provides a reproducible and scalable alternative to expert visual H-scoring and standard semi-automated approaches such as QuPath. Its integration with prognostic modelling reproduced a validated survival signature with performance comparable to expert scoring, supporting clinical and translational applicability. MEL is not a marginal refinement of existing digital scoring methods, but rather a clinically oriented and biologically adaptable framework designed to improve the robustness and reproducibility of automated IHC quantification.
zh_abstract: 我们提出一个基于图像的自动化框架，用于量化免疫组织化学（IHC）图像中的生物标志物表达，并引入标志物表达水平（MEL）评分，作为视觉 H 评分的客观替代方案。MEL 通过整合组织区域分割与肿瘤面积加权的标志物定量、用于减轻样本间和批次间染色变异性的归一化，以及对核、细胞质和膜相关生物标志物的稳健定量，解决了现有自动化方法的关键局限。完整流程已开发为开源 Fiji/ImageJ 工具并公开可用。我们使用 128 例肺腺癌患者的 IHC 图像评估 MEL，这些图像针对 BRCA1、GLUT1 和 QKI 染色，这三种标志物构成本课题组先前描述的预后特征。组织区域使用基于机器学习的 Fiji 插件进行分割，并在肿瘤区域内计算 MEL 评分。一种归一化策略考虑了 TMA 间染色变异性。与视觉 H 评分的一致性使用 Spearman 相关评估。预后性能使用 Cox 回归评估，以推导纳入 MEL 评分和肿瘤分期的联合预后指数（CPI）。分割在各组织区域达到高准确度（Dice 系数 0.69—0.99），但在高度免疫浸润的间质区域性能较低。所有标志物的 MEL 评分均与视觉 H 评分显著相关（{rho} = 0.61—0.69，p < 0.001）。归一化改善了 GLUT1 的一致性（{rho} = 0.39 至 0.62）。推导出的 CPI 将患者分层为不同风险组，其无病生存和总生存差异显著（p < 0.05），与视觉评分相当。MEL 为专家视觉 H 评分和 QuPath 等标准半自动化方法提供了一种可重复且可扩展的替代方案。其与预后建模的整合再现了一个经过验证的生存特征，性能与专家评分相当，支持临床和转化应用。MEL 并非现有数字评分方法的边际改进，而是一个面向临床且具有生物学适应性的框架，旨在提高自动化 IHC 定量的稳健性和可重复性。

title: A Pipeline for Predicting Variant Associations with Complex Disorders via Functional Annotations
zh_title: 基于功能注释预测复杂疾病变异关联的流程
summary: 提出可复现流程，整合GWAS汇总统计与CADD注释生成复杂疾病变异数据集。
key_points: GWAS变异数据异质、不适于直接机器学习
流程含基因组映射与按染色体分层负采样
按EFO术语定义复杂疾病构建可复现数据集
reason: 预印本数据流程工作，未见下游模型性能验证，属增量档
abstract: The study of complex disorders is limited by the lack of structured data sets that integrate genetic association signals with rich functional annotations. While genome wide association studies (GWAS) provide large collections of associated variants, these are heterogeneous, studydependent, and not directly suitable for machine learning applications. Although frameworks such as Combined Annotation Dependent Depletion (CADD) offer comprehensive variant-level features, there is no standardised procedure to construct curated, balanced, and reproducible data sets for the systematic study of complex traits. We introduce a scalable and reproducible pipeline for generating CADD-annotated variant data sets associated with complex disorders defined via Experimental Factor Ontology (EFO) terms. The pipeline integrates GWAS summary statistics, genome mapping, chromosomestratified negative sampling, and large-scale annotation, while addressing class imbalance and feature redundancy. The resulting data sets provide curated, balanced, and annotation-rich representations of variant-trait associations, suitable for statistical learning, systematic model evaluation and comparison, and analysis of functional annotation contributions and interactions.
zh_abstract: 复杂疾病的研究受限于缺乏将遗传关联信号与丰富功能注释整合的结构化数据集。虽然全基因组关联研究（GWAS）提供了大量关联变异集合，但这些变异具有异质性、依赖研究，并且不直接适用于机器学习应用。尽管Combined Annotation Dependent Depletion（CADD）等框架提供了全面的变异水平特征，但尚无标准化流程来构建经整理、平衡且可重复的数据集，以用于复杂性状的系统研究。我们提出一种可扩展且可重复的流程，用于生成与通过实验因子本体（EFO）术语定义的复杂疾病相关的CADD注释变异数据集。该流程整合GWAS汇总统计量、基因组映射、按染色体分层的负采样和大规模注释，同时处理类别不平衡和特征冗余。所得数据集提供了经整理、平衡且注释丰富的变异-性状关联表示，适用于统计学习、系统模型评估与比较，以及功能注释贡献和相互作用的分析。

title: Automated Sleep Staging Performance Across Two Experimental Sleep Manipulation Protocols in Adolescents.
zh_title: 青少年睡眠操纵方案下自动睡眠分期性能评估
summary: 预印本在睡眠限制与慢波睡眠剥夺两个方案中检验POPS、YASA等自动睡眠分期算法对青少年多导睡眠图的判读效度。
key_points: 两方案样本分别为43例与18例
对照人工判读评估POPS、YASA及组合
关注睡眠结构被干预时算法是否稳定
reason: 小样本、单中心预印本效度研究，仅比较算法与人工判读
abstract: Automated sleep staging algorithms improve the scalability of polysomnography analysis in adolescent research but are primarily validated in undisturbed, single-night sleep recordings. It remains unclear whether these algorithms maintain performance when sleep architecture is experimentally manipulated. This study evaluated the validity of two popular automated sleep staging approaches across two distinct sleep manipulation paradigms in adolescents: a sleep restriction protocol (N=43, mean age [SD]=13.37[1.06] years; four nights including two sleep extension [10hr] and two restriction [4hr] nights) and a slow-wave sleep deprivation (SWSD) protocol (N=18, mean age [SD]=17.17[1.79] years; baseline, SWSD, and recovery nights). Automated sleep staging was performed using the POPulation-level Sleep Stager (POPS), the Yet Another Spindle Algorithm (YASA), and combined POPS+YASA. Manual polysomnography scoring by experienced sleep technicians served as the reference standard. Agreement was assessed using Cohen's k, and stage-specific performance was evaluated using F1 scores and confusion matrices. Mixed-effects models tested differences in overall and stage-specific agreement across nights. All staging approaches demonstrated moderate-to-substantial agreement with manual scoring across manipulated sleep conditions (k range; range=0.53-0.76). In the sleep restriction study, agreement was lower in restricted versus extended sleep (P<0.05), and agreement declined across restriction nights, with poorer Wake, N1, and N2 classification, while N3 remained preserved. In the SWSD study, overall agreement was lower on the SWSD night, with poorer N3 classification while other stages were preserved. Automated sleep staging performance may be less consistent in adolescents when sleep is curtailed or fragmented; future studies should develop and validate these algorithms under multiple sleep conditions.
zh_abstract: 自动睡眠分期算法提高了青少年研究中多导睡眠图分析的可扩展性，但主要在未受干扰的单夜睡眠记录中得到验证。目前尚不清楚当睡眠结构受到实验性操纵时，这些算法能否保持性能。本研究在青少年中两种不同的睡眠操纵范式中评估了两种常用自动睡眠分期方法的有效性：一项睡眠限制方案（N=43，平均年龄[SD]=13.37[1.06]岁；四个夜晚包括两个睡眠延长（10小时）夜和两个睡眠限制（4小时）夜）和一项慢波睡眠剥夺（SWSD）方案（N=18，平均年龄[SD]=17.17[1.79]岁；基线夜、SWSD 夜和恢复夜）。自动睡眠分期使用群体水平睡眠分期器（POPulation-level Sleep Stager，POPS）、另一种纺锤波算法（Yet Another Spindle Algorithm，YASA）以及 POPS+YASA 联合进行。由经验丰富的睡眠技师进行的人工多导睡眠图判读作为参考标准。一致性使用 Cohen's k 评估，阶段特异性性能使用 F1 分数和混淆矩阵评估。混合效应模型检验了各夜晚总体一致性和阶段特异性一致性的差异。所有分期方法在受操纵的睡眠条件下均显示与人工判读中等至较高的一致性（k 范围；范围=0.53-0.76）。在睡眠限制研究中，睡眠限制条件下的一致性低于睡眠延长条件（P<0.05），且一致性在连续限制夜中下降，其中清醒（Wake）、N1 和 N2 分类较差，而 N3 保持稳定。在 SWSD 研究中，SWSD 夜总体一致性较低，N3 分类较差，而其他睡眠阶段保持稳定。在青少年中，当睡眠被缩短或碎片化时，自动睡眠分期性能可能较不一致；未来研究应在多种睡眠条件下开发并验证这些算法。

title: Shifted Window Temporal Transformer for YOLO-Guided Phase Recognition in Laparoscopic Cholecystectomy Surgery
zh_title: Swin时序Transformer用于腹腔镜胆囊切除手术阶段识别
summary: 结合Swin Transformer与时序编码器做手术阶段识别，并行YOLOv11s定位器械，在Cholec80测试。
key_points: 因果时序平滑抑制阶段预测闪烁
并行YOLOv11s实时器械定位
仅在公开Cholec80数据集评估
reason: 公开数据集上的方法改进，无外部验证与临床结局，属增量档
abstract: Intelligent operating rooms require accurate awareness of surgical workflow for better intra-operative decisions, teamwork, and surgical documentation. Therefore, accurately recognizing surgical phase during surgery is crucial. However, previous artificial intelligence-based methods provide fluctuating predictions for the transitions, restricting their clinical use. To address this challenge, we propose a clinically meaningful framework that integrates a Swin Transformer and Temporal Transformer Encoder (TTE) for effective surgical phase recognition and a parallel YOLOv11s network for real-time surgical instrument localization. To avoid phase flickering and to produce stable workflow predictions, a causal temporal smoothing is applied. The proposed framework is tested on the Cholec80 dataset for the simultaneous recognition of the surgical phases and instruments. The overall phase recognition accuracy of this model was 92%, and the macro average F1-score was 0.86. This performance surpasses CNN based methods such as EndoNet (81.7%) and SV-RCNet (85.3%), as well as temporal convolutional and transformer-based approaches including TeCNO (88.6%), Trans-SVNet (90.9%), and LoViT (91.5%). Besides, the module of instrument detection achieved mAP@0.5 = 0.863. The reliability of the results is confirmed, obtaining a high recognition rate of the workflows, and a high accuracy of the localization of the instruments. The proposed framework can serve as a foundation for intelligent surgical assistance, enriching situation awareness, and potential robotic surgery applications. Code will be made publicly available at: https://github.com/ac005sheekar/LapChol-Surgery-Swin-Cholec80
zh_abstract: 智能手术室需要准确感知手术工作流程，以便改善术中决策、团队协作和手术记录。因此，在手术过程中准确识别手术阶段至关重要。然而，以往基于人工智能的方法对阶段转换给出波动的预测，限制了其临床使用。为应对这一挑战，我们提出一个具有临床意义的框架，该框架整合 Swin Transformer 和时间 Transformer 编码器（Temporal Transformer Encoder，TTE）以实现有效的手术阶段识别，并并行使用 YOLOv11s 网络进行实时手术器械定位。为避免阶段闪烁并产生稳定的工作流程预测，应用了因果时间平滑。所提出的框架在 Cholec80 数据集上测试，用于同时识别手术阶段和器械。该模型的总体阶段识别准确率为 92%，宏平均 F1 分数为 0.86。该性能超过了基于 CNN 的方法，如 EndoNet（81.7%）和 SV-RCNet（85.3%），以及时间卷积和基于 Transformer 的方法，包括 TeCNO（88.6%）、Trans-SVNet（90.9%）和 LoViT（91.5%）。此外，器械检测模块实现了 mAP@0.5 = 0.863。结果可靠性得到确认，工作流程识别率高，器械定位准确性高。所提出的框架可作为智能手术辅助的基础，丰富态势感知，并具有潜在的机器人手术应用。代码将公开提供于：https://github.com/ac005sheekar/LapChol-Surgery-Swin-Cholec80

title: Semantic-Aware Deformable Feature Alignment for Thyroid Nodule Segmentation in Ultrasound
zh_title: 语义感知可变形特征对齐的超声甲状腺结节分割
summary: 提出SDFA-Net，解耦全局语义与局部几何学习，用于超声甲状腺结节分割。
key_points: 聚类线性上下文聚合建模长程依赖
动态原型调制抑制背景干扰
级联空间对齐实现亚像素融合
reason: 单任务分割方法改进，摘要未体现外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Accurate segmentation of thyroid nodules in ultrasound images is essential for clinical diagnosis yet remains challenging due to boundary ambiguity, speckle noise, and complex geometric variability. Existing methods often fail to reconcile global semantic understanding with precise local boundary delineation, leading to errors in irregular cases. To address this, we propose SDFA-Net, a framework built on semantic-aware deformable feature alignment that explicitly decouples the learning of robust global semantics and detailed local geometry. Our approach integrates three main components: a clustered linear context aggregation module for efficient long-range dependency modeling, an affinity-driven token modulation mechanism using dynamic prototypes to suppress background interference, and a cascaded spatially-aligned feature fusion strategy that achieves sub-pixel geometric alignment across multiple resolution stages. By filtering and aligning multi-scale features, SDFA-Net ensures robust fusion that is both semantically meaningful and geometrically accurate. We validate our method through extensive experiments on three public thyroid ultrasound datasets, TN3K, TUCC, and DDTI, where it demonstrates superior performance over state-of-the-art methods. The proposed framework offers a generalizable solution for precise medical image segmentation in boundary-ambiguous scenarios.
zh_abstract: 超声图像中甲状腺结节的准确分割对于临床诊断至关重要，但由于边界模糊、斑点噪声和复杂几何变异性，仍然具有挑战性。现有方法常常无法协调全局语义理解与精确局部边界描绘，导致不规则病例中的错误。为此，我们提出 SDFA-Net，一个基于语义感知可变形特征对齐的框架，显式解耦稳健全局语义与详细局部几何的学习。我们的方法集成三个主要组件：用于高效长程依赖建模的聚类线性上下文聚合模块；使用动态原型抑制背景干扰的亲和力驱动 token 调制机制；以及跨多个分辨率阶段实现亚像素几何对齐的级联空间对齐特征融合策略。通过过滤和对齐多尺度特征，SDFA-Net 确保融合既具有语义意义又具有几何准确性。我们通过在三个公开甲状腺超声数据集 TN3K、TUCC 和 DDTI 上的大量实验验证了我们的方法，其表现出优于最先进方法的性能。所提出的框架为边界模糊场景中的精确医学图像分割提供了一种可泛化的解决方案。

title: StaX-Net: Stackelberg Interleaved Asymmetric Network for Cross-Modality Medical Image Translation
zh_title: StaX-Net：Stackelberg式交错非对称跨模态医学图像翻译网络
summary: 提出StaX-Net，用部分耦合的编码器-判别器结构与FAST层约束跨模态医学图像合成，稳定主从式训练。
key_points: 生成器与判别器共享部分模块以对齐特征
FAST层在训练中蒸馏目标域先验，推理时仅用源域变换
采用非对称学习率与共享参数冻结的优化方案
reason: 方法类预印本，仅摘要层面描述，无外部验证或临床评估，属增量档
abstract: Cross-modality medical image translation is challenged by anatomically inconsistent synthesis that can compromise clinical diagnosis. We propose StaX-Net, a Stackelberg interleaved asymmetric network that incorporates a partially coupled encoder-discriminator structure, and a 2D feature aggregation and spatial transformation (FAST) layer that distills target-supervised priors under the learning using privileged information paradigm. The shared blocks between the generator and discriminator enhance architectural feature alignment. To stabilize the leader-follower training, a Stackelberg-inspired asymmetric optimization scheme employs explicit shared-parameter freezing and asymmetric learning rates. The FAST layer distills target-domain priors during training and applies a source-only transform at inference. This constrains the synthesis process through target-informed feature representations relative to standard generative architectures. The code is available on GitHub for public use.
zh_abstract: 跨模态医学图像转换受到解剖上不一致的合成结果的挑战，这可能危及临床诊断。我们提出 StaX-Net，一种 Stackelberg 交错非对称网络，其包含部分耦合的编码器-判别器结构，以及一个 2D 特征聚合与空间变换（feature aggregation and spatial transformation, FAST）层，该层在学习使用特权信息（learning using privileged information）范式下蒸馏目标监督先验。生成器与判别器之间的共享块增强了架构特征对齐。为稳定领导者-跟随者训练，一种受 Stackelberg 启发的非对称优化方案采用显式共享参数冻结和非对称学习率。FAST 层在训练期间蒸馏目标域先验，并在推理时应用仅源域变换。相对于标准生成架构，这通过目标信息引导的特征表示约束合成过程。代码已在 GitHub 上公开可用。

title: Energy Efficient Lung Tumor Segmentation with a modified CBAM ENet Skip Model
zh_title: 改进CBAM ENet的轻量能效肺肿瘤分割模型
summary: 预印本提出基于ENet加UNet跳连与CBAM的轻量肺肿瘤分割模型，强调低算力与实时推理。
key_points: ENet主干加UNet式跳连与CBAM注意力
面向低算力与快速推理的临床部署
在TCIA/医学分割十项挑战公开数据上训练
reason: 现有架构组合的增量改进，公开数据但无外部验证或多中心评估
abstract: Lung tumor segmentation plays a vital role in early detection and treatment planning of lung cancer. Although state-of-the-art deep learning models achieve high dice score coefficients (DSC), each forward pass requires computing large amounts of floating point operations, making them computationally expensive, requiring GPU acceleration, and having slow inference speed, limiting real-world clinical deployment. We propose a lightweight, energy-efficient model that leverages the ENet architecture for its real-time inference capability and low computational cost, enhanced with UNet-style skip connections between encoder and decoder stages for feature reuse and the lightweight Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM) for improved feature representation. The model is trained on publicly available data from The Cancer Imaging Archive (TCIA) via the Medical Segmentation Decathlon Challenge (MSD) and evaluated on the Lung Image Database Consortium and Image Database Resource Initiative (LIDC-IDRI) dataset. Our model achieves a DSC of 0.90812 (threshold of 0.5) with its compact architecture of 430,052 parameters and 0.549 Giga Multiply-Accumulate operations (GMAC), making it up to 10 times faster, requires 79 times less GMAC than UNet, and has 22 times fewer parameters than SegNet. These characteristics make it well-suited for deployment in clinical settings where computational resources are limited and decrease the cost of utilizing such a system. Additionally, the explainable AI technique of Grad-CAM is used to provide visual interpretability of the model's predictions and to identify regions where segmentation performance requires improvement.
zh_abstract: 肺部肿瘤分割在肺癌的早期检测和治疗规划中起着至关重要的作用。尽管最先进的深度学习模型实现了较高的Dice相似系数（DSC），但每次前向传播都需要计算大量浮点运算，使其计算代价高昂、需要GPU加速且推理速度慢，限制了真实世界中的临床部署。我们提出了一种轻量级、高能效模型，利用ENet架构实现实时推理能力和低计算成本，并通过编码器与解码器阶段之间的UNet风格跳跃连接增强特征复用，以及通过轻量级卷积块注意力模块（CBAM）改善特征表示。该模型通过医学分割十项挑战赛（MSD）使用癌症影像档案（TCIA）的公开数据进行训练，并在肺图像数据库联盟与图像数据库资源计划（LIDC-IDRI）数据集上进行评估。我们的模型在0.5阈值下达到0.90812的DSC，其紧凑架构具有430,052个参数和0.549吉次乘累加运算（GMAC），使其速度最高快10倍、GMAC需求比UNet少79倍，并且参数数量比SegNet少22倍。这些特性使其非常适合部署在计算资源有限的临床环境中，并降低使用此类系统的成本。此外，使用可解释人工智能技术Grad-CAM提供模型预测的视觉可解释性，并识别分割性能需要改进的区域。

title: Words Are the Voice of the Mind: Depression Severity Estimation from Social Traces via Mental-Guided Evidence Reasoning
zh_title: 基于社交媒体痕迹的心理证据推理抑郁严重度估计
summary: 提出UMer框架，通过用户特定心理先验与细粒度心理证据推理，从社交媒体文本估计抑郁严重度。
key_points: 弥补用户特定心理先验建模不足
引入多样化语义检索与证据层面推理
针对传统量表面访需用户主动参与的局限
reason: 方法新颖但仅摘要信息，无外部临床队列或验证描述，属增量档
abstract: Depression severity estimation is crucial for mental health assessment and intervention, yet traditional approaches depend on clinical interviews or self-report questionnaires that require users' active participation. With the widespread use of online social media, users leave rich social traces that may reflect their mental states, motivating the task of social media-based depression severity estimation. Existing efforts have progressed from textual-feature-based classification to LLM-based questionnaire completion over standardized scale items, yet they still fall short in user-specific mental priors modeling, diversified semantic retrieval, and fine-grained reasoning over mental evidence. To address these limitations, we propose UMer, a user-specific mental evidence reasoning framework for social traces-based depression severity estimation. UMer first distills a user-specific mental prior from historical social traces to capture the user's psychological tendencies, behavioral patterns, and self-expression style. It then performs scale-guided multi-query retrieval to construct evidence memories from item-relevant posts. Finally, it conducts coarse-to-fine evidence-aware reasoning to distinguish direct and indirect evidence and predict item-level scores with interpretable rationales. Extensive experiments on real-world benchmarks demonstrate that UMer not only achieves competitive performance over existing baselines, but also provides evidence-grounded interpretability and generalizes to other scale-based tasks.
zh_abstract: 抑郁严重程度估计对心理健康评估和干预至关重要，然而传统方法依赖需要用户主动参与的临床访谈或自评问卷。随着在线社交媒体的广泛使用，用户留下可能反映其心理状态的丰富社交痕迹，推动了基于社交媒体的抑郁严重程度估计任务。现有工作已从基于文本特征的分类发展到基于大语言模型（LLM）对标准化量表条目进行问卷作答，但它们在用户特定的心理先验建模、多样化语义检索以及对心理证据的细粒度推理方面仍存在不足。为解决这些局限，我们提出 UMer，一种面向基于社交痕迹的抑郁严重程度估计的用户特定心理证据推理框架。UMer 首先从历史社交痕迹中蒸馏用户特定的心理先验，以捕捉用户的心理倾向、行为模式和自我表达风格。然后执行量表引导的多查询检索，从与条目相关的帖子中构建证据记忆。最后进行由粗到细的证据感知推理，以区分直接证据和间接证据，并借助可解释的理由预测条目级得分。在真实世界基准上的大量实验表明，UMer 不仅在现有基线上取得有竞争力的性能，还提供以证据为依据的可解释性，并可泛化到其他基于量表的任务。

title: Perturbation-Based Data Selection for Medical Question Answering
zh_title: 基于扰动的医学问答数据选择
summary: 研究基于高斯扰动表示信号的医学问答训练子集选择，用MedGemma-4B在五个医学QA数据集上评估RSP与RSP-Drop。
key_points: 利用预测翻转频率与边际收缩
仅用问题与选项做选择
五个医学QA数据集小预算评估
reason: 预印本，方法改进幅度有限、仅内部评测，属增量档。
abstract: Selecting a compact training subset is an important step in adapting medical language models from existing question-answering banks. We investigate perturbation-based data selection using two signals derived from Gaussian perturbations of the final-block representation: prediction-change frequency and non-flipping margin contraction. After a shared entropy prefilter, Representation-Sensitivity Prioritization (RSP) combines the signals using automatic root-mean-square scaling, while RSP-Drop ranks candidates by contraction alone. Both selectors use only questions and answer options during selection. We evaluate them with MedGemma-4B on five medical QA datasets at retained-set budgets of 64, 128, and 256 examples. At the primary budget of 128, RSP and RSP-Drop obtain dataset-averaged Macro-F1 scores of 47.55 and 48.28, respectively, compared with 45.11 for entropy-pool-matched random selection. Their relative performance varies across datasets and budgets. A selected-set case study identifies contrasting clean-margin profiles among the examples exchanged by the two rules, while a full-pool ablation shows that entropy prefiltering is not uniformly beneficial. These retrospective results characterize the empirical utility and limitations of perturbation-based selection under a fixed adaptation protocol. Evaluation uses one backbone and benchmarks with documented training-family overlap; it does not establish clinical effectiveness.
zh_abstract: 在从现有问答库适配医学语言模型时，选择一个紧凑的训练子集是重要步骤。我们研究基于扰动的数据选择，使用源自最终块表示高斯扰动的两个信号：预测变化频率和非翻转边际收缩。经过共享的熵预筛选后，表示敏感性优先排序（RSP）使用自动均方根缩放来组合这些信号，而 RSP-Drop 仅按收缩对候选进行排序。两种选择器在选择过程中都只使用问题和答案选项。我们在五个医学问答数据集上使用 MedGemma-4B 评估它们，保留集预算为 64、128 和 256 个示例。在主要预算 128 下，RSP 和 RSP-Drop 获得的数据集平均 Macro-F1 分数分别为 47.55 和 48.28，而熵池匹配的随机选择为 45.11。它们的相对性能因数据集和预算而异。一项选定集案例研究识别出两种规则所交换示例之间具有对比性的干净边际特征，而全池消融显示熵预过滤并非一致有益。这些回顾性结果刻画了在固定适配协议下基于扰动选择的经验效用和局限性。评估使用一个骨干模型和具有记录的训练家族重叠的基准；它并未确立临床有效性。

title: Promise and Limits of Cross-Architecture Knowledge Distillation for Lightweight Medical Vision Transformers (LiteMed-ViT)
zh_title: 轻量医学视觉Transformer的跨架构知识蒸馏
summary: 提出LiteMed-ViT，以双令牌蒸馏将CNN教师知识迁移至0.234M参数的轻量ViT学生，用于边缘端医学图像分析。
key_points: 参数比ResNet18教师少47.8倍，内存0.89MB
在三个MedMNIST子集上准确率高于紧凑CNN基线
仅小规模公开数据集验证，无外部临床验证
reason: 小规模基准数据集上的轻量模型改进，无外部验证，属增量档
abstract: Running deep models for medical image analysis at the point of care is challenging with standard architectures: convolutional neural networks (CNNs) are often too heavy for edge devices, while Vision Transformers (ViTs) require massive training datasets to compensate for missing inductive biases. This study investigates how far the dual-token distillation used to train data-efficient ViTs can be pushed when applied across architectures, from a CNN-based teacher into a lightweight ViT student. LiteMed-ViT is introduced as a dual-token ViT featuring a convolutional stem and a class-balanced distillation objective; at 0.234M parameters, LiteMed-ViT carries 47.8x fewer parameters than its ResNet18 teacher at a memory footprint of just 0.89 MB. Evaluated against three compact CNN baselines on three MedMNIST subsets of varying modality and class balance, LiteMed-ViT attains higher accuracy than all three baselines on BloodMNIST (95.05%) and two on PathMNIST (89.15%). Under MedMNIST-C corruptions, it is at least as robust as every compact CNN across all subsets, outperforming them on BloodMNIST and PathMNIST without declining in relative standing as severity increases. Particular attention is devoted to identifying the exact conditions where performance plateaus. On DermaMNIST, LiteMed-ViT's balanced accuracy remains up to 1.9 points below the strongest compact CNNs and does not benefit from higher input resolutions up to 224 pixels, where ResNet18 gains 12.6 points. Stronger teachers do not yield a more accurate student, and overconfident ones lower its DermaMNIST balanced accuracy unless calibrated.
zh_abstract: 在护理点运行深度模型进行医学图像分析时，标准架构面临挑战：卷积神经网络（CNN）对边缘设备而言往往过于沉重，而视觉Transformer（ViT）需要海量训练数据集来补偿缺失的归纳偏置。本研究探讨用于训练数据高效ViT的双令牌蒸馏在跨架构应用——从基于CNN的教师模型到轻量级ViT学生模型——时能推进到何种程度。引入LiteMed-ViT，一种双令牌ViT，具有卷积主干和类别平衡蒸馏目标；在0.234M参数下，LiteMed-ViT的参数比其ResNet18教师少47.8倍，内存占用仅0.89 MB。在三个模态和类别平衡不同的MedMNIST子集上，与三个紧凑CNN基线相比，LiteMed-ViT在BloodMNIST（95.05%）上准确率高于所有三个基线，在PathMNIST（89.15%）上高于其中两个基线。在MedMNIST-C损坏下，它在所有子集上至少与每个紧凑CNN一样稳健，在BloodMNIST和PathMNIST上优于它们，且随着严重程度增加相对排名不下降。特别关注识别性能平台期的确切条件。在DermaMNIST上，LiteMed-ViT的平衡准确率仍比最强紧凑CNN低多达1.9个百分点，并且从高达224像素的更高输入分辨率中无获益，而ResNet18在此获得12.6个百分点。更强的教师并不会产生更准确的学生，过度自信的教师会降低其DermaMNIST平衡准确率，除非经过校准。

title: VTRL-Med: Progressive Visual Refinement with Topology-Guided Regularization for Medical Image Clustering
zh_title: VTRL-Med：拓扑引导正则的医学图像聚类
summary: 提出VTRL-Med框架，借助SAM提取结构特征并以拓扑引导正则，改善无标注医学图像数据的深度聚类。
key_points: 用适配后的SAM特征保留掩膜预训练的结构线索
引入连通性、孔洞等拓扑模式作为全局几何约束
针对无标注医学图像数据的聚类任务
reason: 方法有新意但无外部验证与临床结局，属预印本方法档
abstract: Deep clustering offers a promising approach for analyzing large unlabeled medical image datasets, yet prevailing methods still face two limitations: they may neglect class-agnostic structural priors that capture object boundaries and regions, and they do not explicitly encode topological patterns (e.g., connectivity and holes). These sources of information play distinct and complementary roles: visual-structural features provide the primary discriminative representation for clustering, while topological features provide additional global geometric cues for residual visual ambiguities. We introduce VTRL-Med, a progressive visual-structural learning framework with topology-guided regularization for medical image clustering. VTRL-Med first adapts the Segment Anything Model (SAM) to extract image features that retain structural cues inherited from mask-supervised pretraining. It then generates reliable pseudo-labels through a two-step filtering process that combines prototype-based selection with k-nearest neighbor consistency validation. Finally, it progressively refines the visual branch while an auxiliary topology branch, constructed from persistent homology (PH) descriptors, provides additional geometric regularization during training. Across 13 medical image benchmarks, VTRL-Med achieves state-of-the-art clustering performance, improving average accuracy by 4.48% over existing methods. On three representative datasets, topology-guided regularization further improves accuracy by 1.3--4.3% over visual refinement alone.
zh_abstract: 深度聚类为分析大型无标签医学图像数据集提供了一种有前景的方法，但现有方法仍面临两个局限：它们可能忽略捕获对象边界和区域的类别无关结构先验，并且没有显式编码拓扑模式（如连通性和孔洞）。这些信息来源发挥不同且互补的作用：视觉-结构特征提供聚类的主要判别表示，而拓扑特征为残余视觉歧义提供额外的全局几何线索。我们提出VTRL-Med，一种用于医学图像聚类的、带拓扑引导正则化的渐进式视觉-结构学习框架。VTRL-Med首先适配Segment Anything Model（SAM）以提取保留从掩码监督预训练继承的结构线索的图像特征。然后，它通过两步过滤过程生成可靠伪标签，该过程结合基于原型的选择与k近邻一致性验证。最后，它逐步细化视觉分支，同时由持续同调（PH）描述子构建的辅助拓扑分支在训练期间提供额外几何正则化。在13个医学图像基准上，VTRL-Med实现最先进聚类性能，较现有方法平均准确率提高4.48%。在三个代表性数据集上，拓扑引导正则化较仅视觉细化进一步提高准确率1.3--4.3%。

title: Every Edge Needs a Quote: Building a Quote-Grounded Knowledge Graph of Healthcare Software Adoption with Language-Model Agents
zh_title: 每条边需有引文：智能体构建医疗软件采用知识图谱
summary: 用确定性爬取加预算受限ReAct智能体，从公开网页抽取医院软件客户与集成关系，要求每条边有逐字引文支撑。
key_points: 规则要求每条关系边均有源页面逐字引文支持
结合厂商站点确定性爬取与网页搜索智能体
目标是核验同级机构采用某软件的可信证据
reason: 预印本方法思路清晰但场景较窄、缺少量化评测结果，属增量档
abstract: Hospitals regularly buy software that clinicians and patients depend on. Because these purchases are costly, hard to reverse and can affect patient care, buyers look for evidence of which peer institutions already use a product and which systems it connects to. This evidence is public but scattered across vendor websites, press releases and third-party pages. Language-model agents can now collect it at low cost, but the correctness of the extracted claims is difficult to establish, and a wrongly listed customer can mislead buyers and misrepresent an organisation. We present a pipeline that builds a knowledge graph of customer and integration relations from the open web under one rule: every edge must be supported by a verbatim quote from its source page. Pages come from a deterministic crawl of each vendor's site and a budgeted ReAct agent that searches the rest of the web. A permissive extractor proposes relations with quotes, and a layered grounding stage decides which to keep, using a referent step that reads the whole page when a quote names only one side, deterministic checks, and a panel of five model calls voting on nine criteria. On 61 vendors, the pipeline reaches 0.94 precision and 0.71 recall against a page-level key covering the 6,428 candidate relations proposed by its extractor, whose verdicts were drafted by one model and re-checked with a second. Against the golden reference, the marketplace's own curated list, it scores lower, but 89% of the relations it keeps that the reference lacks are stated on a page. A confidence score built from the panel's votes keeps more correct relations than the fixed rule at the same precision, and reaches 0.90 precision at 0.90 recall. We also discuss how narrow, bounded model calls, string-matched evidence and voting address long-context degradation and run-to-run variance.
zh_abstract: 医院经常购买临床医生和患者所依赖的软件。由于这些采购成本高昂、难以逆转且可能影响患者护理，买家会寻找证据，了解哪些同行机构已经使用某产品以及该产品连接哪些系统。这些证据是公开的，但分散在供应商网站、新闻稿和第三方页面上。语言模型智能体现在能以低成本收集这些证据，但所提取声明的正确性难以确认，而错误列出的客户可能误导买家并错误呈现某个组织。我们提出一个流水线，从开放网络构建客户与集成关系的知识图谱，遵循一条规则：每条边都必须由其来源页面中的逐字引文支持。页面来自对每个供应商网站的确定性爬取，以及一个预算受限的 ReAct 智能体对其余网络的搜索。一个宽松的抽取器提出带引文的关系，分层接地阶段决定保留哪些关系，使用一个指代步骤（当引文只提到一侧时读取整个页面）、确定性检查，以及由五次模型调用组成的小组按九项标准投票。在 61 个供应商上，该流水线相对于覆盖其抽取器提出的 6,428 个候选关系的页面级键，达到 0.94 精确率和 0.71 召回率；该键的判定由一个模型起草并由第二个模型复核。相对于黄金参考，即市场自身整理的列表，它的得分较低，但它保留的而参考中缺失的关系中有 89% 在某个页面上有陈述。由小组投票构建的置信度分数在相同精确率下比固定规则保留更多正确关系，并在 0.90 召回率时达到 0.90 精确率。我们还讨论狭窄、有界的模型调用、字符串匹配证据和投票如何应对长上下文退化与运行间方差。

title: Semantic Representation for Agentic Self-Play in Automated Laboratories
zh_title: VERID：自动化实验室的语义数字孪生基础设施
summary: 提出实验室工作单元的语义数字孪生基础设施，以衔接AI智能体推理与湿实验物理执行。
key_points: 面向智能体自博弈的实验室语义数字孪生
提供可查询内省与压缩时间模拟
目标解决实验设计到物理执行瓶颈
reason: 基础设施类预印本，摘要未见验证数据，属增量档
abstract: Navigating complex, high-dimensional biological search spaces necessitates scalable physical and computational intelligence to explore beyond local optima through iterative self-play across ideation, experimentation, and automation. Translating experimental designs into reliable physical execution remains bottlenecked by static laboratory automation and unmodeled physical variability. To address this, we introduce VERified Infrastructure for Discovery Laboratories, or VERID, a foundational infrastructure designed to bridge the gap between the high-level reasoning of artificial intelligence (AI) agents and complex, error-prone physical realities of wet labs. VERID is a persistent, high-fidelity semantic digital twin of the laboratory workcell that provides four core services: queryable introspection for agentic reasoning, time-compressed simulation for protocol validation, comprehensive trace persistence for a complete scientific record, and a framework for safe execution. We present three case studies using aqueous dye and deionized water mixtures to validate the optical and fluidic foundations of VERID. These studies demonstrate how VERID enables pre-emptive detection of critical errors in experimental protocols, stateful mid-run error recovery and post-hoc identification of subtle physical failures. The simulation functions as a discrete accounting engine, allowing agents to safely and inexpensively explore experimental designs in silico and refine experimental strategies through iterative self-play. VERID also captures structured multimodal experimental data for downstream analysis, knowledge mining and agent training. We argue that this semantic layer is an essential prerequisite for deploying autonomous agents in the biochemical and biomedical sciences, ensuring data integrity, operational safety, and paving the way for tackling previously intractable grand challenges in biology.
zh_abstract: 在复杂、高维的生物搜索空间中导航，需要可扩展的物理与计算智能，通过跨构思、实验和自动化的迭代自我博弈来探索超越局部最优的方案。将实验设计转化为可靠的物理执行，仍受限于静态的实验室自动化和未建模的物理变异性。为解决这一问题，我们引入用于发现实验室的验证基础设施（VERified Infrastructure for Discovery Laboratories，VERID），这是一种基础性基础设施，旨在弥合人工智能（AI）智能体的高层推理与湿实验室复杂、易出错的物理现实之间的差距。VERID 是实验室工作单元的持久、高保真语义数字孪生，提供四项核心服务：用于智能体推理的可查询内省、用于方案验证的时间压缩仿真、用于完整科学记录的全流程轨迹持久化，以及安全执行框架。我们展示了三项使用水性染料和去离子水混合物的案例研究，以验证 VERID 的光学和流体学基础。这些研究证明 VERID 如何能够预先检测实验方案中的关键错误、实现运行中途的状态化错误恢复，以及事后识别细微的物理故障。该仿真充当离散核算引擎，使智能体能够安全且低成本地在计算机中探索实验设计，并通过迭代自我博弈改进实验策略。VERID 还捕获结构化多模态实验数据，用于下游分析、知识挖掘和智能体训练。我们认为，这一语义层是在生物化学和生物医学科学中部署自主智能体的必要前提，可确保数据完整性和操作安全，并为应对生物学中以往难以解决的重大挑战铺平道路。

title: Investigating the trackability of landmarks in NBI and WLI
zh_title: NBI与WLI内镜标志点可追踪性比较
summary: 在61段喉内镜视频中比较窄带与白光成像下标志点跟踪误差，NBI在声带区域显著降低误差。
key_points: 纳入39例患者共61段内镜视频
比较CSRT与两种学习型点跟踪器
NBI在声带区显著降低前向-后向误差
reason: 小样本技术比较，仅报告跟踪误差指标，无外部验证或临床结局，属增量档。
abstract: Reliable visual tracking of anatomical landmarks in endoscopic video is a key prerequisite for computer-assisted interventions in laryngeal surgery. While Narrow Band Imaging (NBI) is clinically established for enhancing vascular contrast, its effect on automated tracking relative to conventional White Light Imaging (WLI) remains unexplored. We present a quantitative comparison of landmark trackability in NBI and WLI using a forward-backward error framework applied to 61 endoscopic videos from 39 patients. Two regions of interest are evaluated: the vocal folds (VF) and mucosa with a prominent vascular pattern (MPVP). We compare a classical feature-based tracker (CSRT) against learning-based point trackers (CoTracker3-Online and TrackOnR) across both modalities. NBI consistently reduced the forward-backward error in both regions, reaching statistical significance for the vocal folds, while failure rates stayed low. These findings indicate that NBI can improve tracking robustness in laryngeal endoscopy, with implications for motion analysis, navigation, and robotic assistance.
zh_abstract: 在内镜视频中对解剖标志进行可靠的视觉跟踪是喉部手术计算机辅助干预的关键前提。虽然窄带成像（NBI）在增强血管对比度方面已在临床上确立，但其相对于传统白光成像（WLI）对自动跟踪的影响仍未得到探索。我们使用前向-后向误差框架，对来自39例患者的61段内镜视频进行了NBI与WLI中标志可跟踪性的定量比较。评估了两个感兴趣区域：声带（VF）和具有显著血管模式的黏膜（MPVP）。我们在两种模态下比较了经典基于特征的跟踪器（CSRT）与基于学习的点跟踪器（CoTracker3-Online和TrackOnR）。NBI在两种区域中均持续降低前向-后向误差，在声带达到统计学显著性，同时失败率保持较低。这些发现表明，NBI可提高喉内镜中的跟踪稳健性，并对运动分析、导航和机器人辅助具有重要意义。

title: Comparing an AI-driven Hearing Test With the Standard Hearing Test in Adults With Hearing Loss and Tinnitus
zh_title: AI 听力测试与标准听力测试对比试验
summary: 伦敦大学学院注册一项观察性研究，在 84 名伴耳鸣的听力损失成人中比较 AI 驱动听力测试与纯音测听。

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: University College, London; conditions: Sensorineural Hearing Loss, Tinnitus; type: OBSERVATIONAL; enrollment: 84; status: ENROLLING_BY_INVITATION] Background and study aims Hearing problems are becoming more common. In the UK around 18 million adults have hearing loss or hear ringing or buzzing in their ears, which is called tinnitus. Many people wait a long time to be seen, partly because there are not enough audiologists - the specialists who test hearing and treat hearing problems. The standard hearing test is called pure-tone audiometry. An audiologist plays quiet sounds at different pitches through headphones and the person presses a button each time they hear one. The test is accurate, but it takes 20 to 30 minutes to complete, and needs a trained audiologist for all of that time. For people with tinnitus and comorbidity it can be especially tiring and slow. The research team has built a version of this test that uses artificial intelligence, called AI-PTA. Instead of following a fixed pattern, it chooses each sound based on the responses already given, which should mean fewer sound presentations are needed to find the same result. The audiologist stays with the person throughout and remains in charge of the test. This study asks three questions. 1. Does AI-PTA give the same hearing results as the standard test? 2. Is it quicker? 3. And do patients and staff find it acceptable? Who can participate? Adults aged 18 or over who have been diagnosed with sensorineural hearing loss, either with or without tinnitus, and who are due to attend the Royal National ENT \& Eastman Dental Hospital in London. Participants need enough English to read and complete questionnaires and to be able to give informed consent. People who have or report hyperacusis (an unusual sensitivity to everyday sounds), an active ear infection, or recent ear surgery cannot take part. What does the study involve? People who are interested are sent information about two weeks before a hospital appointment they already have. Those who decide to take part come in about 30 minutes early, meet a research audiologist, discuss the study, and if happy to take part, sign a consent form. They fill in a short questionnaire about their hearing health. They then have two hearing tests at that visit: the standard test, which is part of their normal care, and the AI-PTA test. Half of the participants have the standard test first and half have AI-PTA first, so that the order does not affect the results. They come back within a week for a shorter appointment, about 40 minutes, to repeat the AI-PTA test. This shows whether it gives the same response
zh_abstract: 【新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：University College, London；疾病：感音神经性听力损失、耳鸣；类型：OBSERVATIONAL；入组人数：84；状态：ENROLLING_BY_INVITATION】【背景和研究目的】听力问题正变得越来越常见。在英国，约 1800 万成年人有听力损失或耳内听到铃声或嗡嗡声，这称为耳鸣。许多人等待很长时间才能就诊，部分原因是听力学家不足——听力学家是检测听力和治疗听力问题的专科医生。标准听力测试称为纯音测听。听力学家通过耳机播放不同音高的轻微声音，受试者每次听到声音时按下一个按钮。该测试准确，但需要 20 至 30 分钟完成，并且整个过程中都需要一名受过培训的听力学家。对于伴有耳鸣和合并症的人，这可能尤其令人疲劳且缓慢。研究团队构建了该测试的一个使用人工智能的版本，称为 AI-PTA。它不遵循固定模式，而是根据已经给出的回答选择每个声音，这应意味着找到相同结果所需的声音呈现次数更少。听力学家全程陪伴受试者，并继续负责该测试。本研究提出三个问题。1. AI-PTA 是否给出与标准测试相同的听力结果？2. 它是否更快？3. 患者和工作人员是否认为它可以接受？【谁可以参与？】年龄 18 岁或以上、已被诊断为感音神经性听力损失（伴或不伴耳鸣），并计划前往伦敦 Royal National ENT & Eastman Dental Hospital 就诊的成年人。参与者需要具备足够的英语能力来阅读和完成问卷，并能够给出知情同意。患有或报告听觉过敏（对日常声音异常敏感）、活动性耳部感染或近期耳部手术的人不能参加。【研究涉及什么？】感兴趣的人会在已有医院预约前约两周收到研究信息。决定参加的人会提前约 30 分钟到达，与研究听力学家会面，讨论研究；如果愿意参加，则签署知情同意书。他们填写一份关于听力健康的简短问卷。随后在该次就诊中进行两项听力测试：标准测试（属于其常规护理的一部分）和 AI-PTA 测试。一半参与者先做标准测试，一半先做 AI-PTA，以避免顺序影响结果。他们会在一周内回来参加一次约 40 分钟的较短预约，以重复 AI-PTA 测试。这显示它是否给出相同的反应

abstract: [Newly registered clinical trial, no results yet; sponsor: University of Sao Paulo General Hospital; conditions: Spinal Cord Injuries (SCI); type: INTERVENTIONAL; phase: NA; enrollment: 24; status: ENROLLING_BY_INVITATION] The goal of this clinical trial is to investigate whether personalized multi-electrode transcutaneous spinal cord stimulation (tSCS), guided by machine learning (ML) and combined with gait training, can improve walking function in people with spinal cord injury or stroke compared with single-electrode tonic stimulation combined with the same training. tSCS is a non-invasive technique that delivers electrical pulses through electrodes placed on the skin over the spine to modulate spinal neural circuits, facilitate the recruitment of lower-limb muscles, and support the recovery of voluntary movements. Conventional tSCS typically uses a single stimulation electrode, which may limit selective recruitment of different muscle groups. This study investigates a personalized multi-electrode approach to selectively recruit specific lower-limb muscle groups and deliver stimulation at appropriate phases of the gait cycle, with the aim of improving walking function. The main questions this study aims to answer are: 1. How do electrode positions and stimulation intensities affect selective muscle recruitment, and how do responses vary between participants and days? 2. Can ML-based optimization identify stimulation settings with selectivity comparable to complete mapping of muscle responses, using fewer tests and less time? 3. Does personalized multi-electrode stimulation, synchronized with specific gait phases, improve walking function more than single-electrode tonic stimulation when both are combined with gait training? The study includes 24 participants (14 with spinal cord injury and 10 with stroke) and consists of two stages. Stage 1 - Characterization of tSCS Selectivity and Stimulation Optimization All participants complete two experimental sessions while lying down. Researchers compare muscle responses to stimulation at a central electrode and at multiple spinal electrode locations. Electrical responses in the leg muscles are recorded using surface electromyography (EMG), and spinal reflexes are assessed using paired electrical pulses. By systematically testing electrode positions and stimulation intensities, researchers build a map of which leg muscles respond to each setting (stimulation landscape). They assess the selective recruitment of different muscle groups, compare stimulation locations, and examine differences between participants and across the two sessions. They also test whether ML-based optimization can find similarly selective settings more effici
zh_abstract: 【新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办者：圣保罗大学总医院（University of Sao Paulo General Hospital）；疾病：脊髓损伤（SCI）；类型：干预性（INTERVENTIONAL）；分期：NA；入组人数：24；状态：ENROLLING_BY_INVITATION】本临床试验的目标是研究由机器学习（ML）引导的个性化多电极经皮脊髓刺激（tSCS）联合步态训练，与单电极持续性刺激联合相同训练相比，能否改善脊髓损伤或卒中患者的步行功能。tSCS 是一种非侵入性技术，通过放置在脊柱上方皮肤上的电极传递电脉冲，以调控脊髓神经环路、促进下肢肌肉的募集，并支持自主运动的恢复。传统 tSCS 通常使用单个刺激电极，这可能限制对不同肌群的选择性募集。本研究探讨一种个性化多电极方法，以选择性募集特定下肢肌群，并在步态周期的适当相位传递刺激，旨在改善步行功能。本研究旨在回答的主要问题包括：1. 电极位置和刺激强度如何影响选择性肌肉募集，并且反应在参与者之间和不同日期之间如何变化？2. 基于 ML 的优化能否使用更少的测试和更少的时间，识别出选择性可与肌肉反应完整映射相媲美的刺激设置？3. 当二者均联合步态训练时，与单电极持续性刺激相比，与特定步态相位同步的个性化多电极刺激能否更大程度地改善步行功能？该研究包括 24 名参与者（14 名脊髓损伤患者和 10 名卒中患者），分为两个阶段。阶段 1——tSCS 选择性表征与刺激优化 所有参与者在仰卧状态下完成两次实验场次。研究人员比较中央电极和多个脊柱电极位置刺激引起的肌肉反应。使用表面肌电图（EMG）记录腿部肌肉的电反应，并使用成对电脉冲评估脊髓反射。通过系统测试电极位置和刺激强度，研究人员构建了每种设置下哪些腿部肌肉发生反应的地图（刺激景观）。他们评估不同肌群的选择性募集，比较刺激位置，并检查参与者之间以及两次实验场次之间的差异。他们还测试基于 ML 的优化能否更高效地找到具有相似选择性的设置

zh_abstract: [新注册临床试验，尚无结果；申办方：印度尼西亚大学；疾病/状况：睡眠-觉醒障碍、睡眠起始和维持障碍、HIV感染；类型：干预性；分期：不适用；入组人数：100；状态：尚未招募] 睡眠不佳在HIV感染者中很常见，并与疲劳、心理困扰以及抗逆转录病毒治疗依从性较差相关。本研究开发一款移动睡眠卫生导师，使用人工智能提供个性化睡眠建议，并配有仪表板，使护士能够跟踪参与者并对风险作出响应。该导师与HIV感染成人和HIV护士共同构建，然后进行可用性和可行性测试。在主要评估中，约70名睡眠不佳的HIV感染成人每天使用该导师，持续四周，并接受两次在线护士会话，四周后进行随访。该研究测量睡眠质量、失眠严重程度、抑郁、焦虑和压力、疲劳、抗逆转录病毒治疗依从性、技术接受度、参与度和安全性。

summary: 148 名药学二年级学生接受 AI 助手按评分标准生成的作业反馈，并通过问卷评价其准确性、清晰度与学习影响。

abstract: [Pharmacy (Basel, Switzerland)] The integration of artificial intelligence (AI) into educational environments is accelerating, with growing interest in its potential to enhance learning outcomes. This pilot study aimed to assess student perceptions regarding the quality and educational impact of AI-generated feedback. Second-professional-year pharmacy students (n = 148) enrolled in a drug literature evaluation course received AI-generated feedback for a draft assignment which required students to critically evaluate a recently published journal article. Feedback was generated by an AI assistant that offered iterative feedback based on the assignment rubric. After the activity, students completed an electronic survey instrument evaluating the AI feedback regarding its alignment with rubric criteria, accuracy, clarity, and tone. Student perceptions of the feedback's impact on learning were also assessed. A total of 148 students (100%) completed the activity and responded to at least one item of the survey tool. Most students agreed with the AI-generated feedback for each section of the assignment in regard to clarity (61.5% to 76.2%) and tone (66.9% to 74.3%), with lower agreement related to alignment with the rubric (33.8% to 60.4%) and accuracy (34.5% to 54.2%). Students also expressed concern about the reliability of AI feedback (71.2%) and risk for plagiarism (50%). AI-generated feedback was positively received in some areas. However, students expressed apprehension regarding its accuracy, reliability, and potential accusation of plagiarism. These findings suggest further refinement is necessary to enhance AI trustworthiness and educational value in academic settings.
zh_abstract: [Pharmacy (Basel, Switzerland)] 人工智能（AI）融入教育环境的进程正在加速，人们对其提升学习结果的潜力日益关注。本试点研究旨在评估学生对 AI 生成反馈的质量和教育影响的看法。修读药物文献评价课程的第二专业年药学学生（n = 148）针对一项要求学生对近期发表的期刊文章进行批判性评价的初稿作业，获得了 AI 生成的反馈。反馈由 AI 助手生成，该助手根据作业评分标准提供迭代反馈。活动结束后，学生完成了一份电子调查工具，从与评分标准条目的一致性、准确性、清晰度和语气方面评价 AI 反馈。还评估了学生对反馈对学习影响的看法。共有 148 名学生（100%）完成了活动，并回答了调查工具中的至少一个条目。多数学生在作业各部分的清晰度（61.5% 至 76.2%）和语气（66.9% 至 74.3%）方面同意 AI 生成的反馈，而在与评分标准的一致性（33.8% 至 60.4%）和准确性（34.5% 至 54.2%）方面同意度较低。学生还表达了对 AI 反馈可靠性（71.2%）和剽窃风险（50%）的担忧。AI 生成的反馈在某些方面受到积极评价。然而，学生对其准确性、可靠性以及可能被指控剽窃表示忧虑。这些发现表明，需要进一步改进，以提高 AI 在学术环境中的可信度和教育价值。

title: A Computationally Efficient Non-Interpolation Virtual Trellis Approach for Mammogram Gradient-based Patterns Analysis

summary: 预印本提出非插值虚拟网格算子 NVHT，在不做六边形变换的前提下降低计算与存储开销，用于钼靶特征提取与分类。
key_points: 提出无需插值、无需网格变换的滤波算子
目标是降低计算与特征缓存成本
应用于乳腺疾病分类的特征提取与精度改进
reason: 方法类预印本，未见外部验证与充分对照，属增量档
abstract: Feature analysis is a crucial step in medical image analysis, particularly in breast cancer classification. Traditional image analysis methods often struggle with optimal patterns along the diagonal axis, computational efficiency and feature buffer storage. Different classical operators require high-efficiency hardware for the complex operations, such as image convolution and gradient analysis, which are used for processing complex machine learning models for training and test operations. Here, in this research, we introduce a non-interpolation virtual trellis-based (NVHT) operator that utilizes a filter kernel over the same square image without transformation to a hexagonal trellis. This proposed method is very efficient in reducing computational and storage costs. The proposed operator is used for improved feature extraction efficiency and accuracy in disease classification. This method outperforms conventional approaches by leveraging a hexagonal pixel representation while maintaining high sensitivity in different directions with less storage.
zh_abstract: 特征分析是医学图像分析中的关键步骤，尤其是在乳腺癌分类中。传统图像分析方法往往难以处理对角轴上的最优模式、计算效率和特征缓冲区存储问题。不同的经典算子需要高效硬件来执行复杂操作，如图像卷积和梯度分析，这些操作被用于处理复杂机器学习模型的训练和测试操作。在本研究中，我们引入一种非插值虚拟网格基（NVHT）算子，该算子在同一方形图像上使用滤波核，而不转换为六边形网格。所提方法在降低计算和存储成本方面非常高效。所提算子用于提高疾病分类中特征提取的效率和准确性。该方法通过利用六边形像素表示，同时在各个方向上保持高灵敏度且存储更少，优于传统方法。

abstract: Type 2 diabetes is a widespread chronic disease that requires early and accurate diagnosis to prevent serious complications. Traditional diagnostic methods often lack sufficient accuracy, which highlights the need for more reliable computational solutions. In this study, we propose a model that integrates the Random Forest classifier with the Bat Optimization Algorithm for simultaneous feature selection and hyperparameter tuning. The SMOTE-ENN method was first applied to the Pima Indians Diabetes Database to correct class imbalance and remove noisy or ambiguous samples, producing a more balanced and cleaner dataset. The optimized model trained on this refined dataset achieved 89% accuracy, 88% precision, 90% recall, and an F1-score of 89%, clearly outperforming the baseline Random Forest and other existing approaches. These results demonstrate the potential of combining evolutionary algorithms with ensemble learning to provide a practical and cost-effective tool for early detection of type 2 diabetes in clinical practice.
zh_abstract: 2型糖尿病是一种广泛存在的慢性疾病，需要早期、准确的诊断以预防严重并发症。传统诊断方法往往缺乏足够准确性，这凸显了对更可靠计算解决方案的需求。在本研究中，我们提出一种将随机森林分类器与蝙蝠优化算法相结合的模型，用于同时进行特征选择和超参数调优。首先将SMOTE-ENN方法应用于皮马印第安人糖尿病数据库（Pima Indians Diabetes Database），以纠正类别不平衡并去除噪声或模糊样本，从而生成更平衡、更干净的数据集。在该精炼数据集上训练的优化模型达到89%准确率、88%精确率、90%召回率和89%的F1分数，明显优于基线随机森林和其他现有方法。这些结果证明了将进化算法与集成学习相结合，为临床实践中2型糖尿病早期检测提供实用且成本效益高的工具的潜力。

title: Human oversight of erroneous clinical AI and decision support a systematic review and meta analysis
zh_title: 临床AI错误输出的人类监督：系统综述与Meta分析
summary: 系统综述与Meta分析汇总46项报告，发现医生对错误自动化建议的纠错能力有限，真实世界心电图研究中有26.6%错误未被识别或纠正。

reason: 系统综述/Meta分析纳入46项报告并含真实世界研究，结论明确，属重要档
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) increasingly supports clinical decisions, but human oversight is protective only if clinicians recognize and resist erroneous output. We systematically reviewed controlled and real-world studies of clinician responses to incorrect automated advice. Forty-six reports represented 41 independent cohort clusters, including 40 core cohorts. Across three adjusted cohorts, clinician correctness was substantially higher with correct than incorrect automated advice (pooled OR 10.19, 95% CI 7.43–13.98; I² = 0%); a ≥ 2020 sensitivity analysis was similar but imprecise (OR 9.22, 95% CI 2.06–41.13). In four heterogeneous real-world computerized ECG studies, 26.6% of erroneous interpretations were not corrected or recognized (95% CI 6.4–65.6%; I² = 95.8%). Contemporary AI and large language model studies also documented harmful reliance but were too heterogeneous for pooling. Patient-level adverse events were reported in one retrospective cohort. Human oversight should be evaluated as an error-interception capability rather than assumed to ensure safety.
zh_abstract: 人工智能（AI）越来越多地支持临床决策，但只有当临床医生识别并抵制错误输出时，人工监督才具有保护作用。我们系统综述了临床医生对错误自动化建议反应的对照研究和真实世界研究。46 篇报告代表 41 个独立队列集群，包括 40 个核心队列。在三个校正队列中，自动化建议正确时临床医生的正确性显著高于建议错误时（合并 OR 10.19，95% CI 7.43–13.98；I² = 0%）；≥2020 年的敏感性分析结果相似但不精确（OR 9.22，95% CI 2.06–41.13）。在四项异质性真实世界计算机化心电图研究中，26.6% 的错误判读未被纠正或识别（95% CI 6.4–65.6%；I² = 95.8%）。当代 AI 和大语言模型研究也记录到有害依赖，但异质性太大，无法合并。一项回顾性队列报告了患者层面的不良事件。人工监督应作为一种错误拦截能力来评估，而不应假定其能确保安全。

title: A deep learning framework for automated cervical spinal cord vertebral labeling and morphometric extraction from brain MRI with large-scale multicenter validation

summary: 基于nnU-Net等模型构建C1–C3椎体自动标记与形态测量流程，纳入32个中心1877例并做外部验证。

外部验证使用四个公开数据集共2737例MRI

reason: 多中心大数据量并完成独立公开数据集外部验证，属重要档
abstract: This study aimed to develop and validate a fully automated pipeline for vertebral level identification (C1–C3) of the upper cervical spinal cord (SC) in T1-weighted brain MRI with a quality control module to assess the generated masks. MRI data from 998 controls and 879 patients with hereditary ataxias (32 sites; age 5–85 years; 46% male) were used to train deep learning models (nnU-Net, U-Net with deep supervision, SwinUNETR) for automatic vertebral labeling of C1–C3 levels. A secondary model based on VGG, ResNet, and EfficientNet architectures was trained to identify vertebral labeling errors. The pipeline also generates image quality metrics including signal-to-noise ratio, contrast-to-noise ratio, coefficient of joint variation, and entropy focus criterion. External validation was performed using 2737 MRIs from four public datasets, and clinical utility was demonstrated in a longitudinal cohort of 51 patients with multiple sclerosis. The nnU-Net achieved the highest performance (Dice: C1 = 0.85, C2 = 0.89, C3 = 0.89), labeling 95.8% of mislabeled cases from the Spinal Cord Toolbox. The VGG-based classifier achieved 97.9% accuracy and 98.7% sensitivity. External validation showed labeling accuracies exceeding 92% in four of five datasets and sensitivity to longitudinal SC atrophy in multiple sclerosis. This pipeline enables scalable, reliable vertebral labeling and morphometric extraction of the upper cervical SC for multicenter studies and supports biomarker development in neurodegenerative diseases.
zh_abstract: 本研究旨在开发并验证一个全自动流程，用于在 T1 加权脑 MRI 中识别上颈髓（upper cervical spinal cord，SC）的椎体水平（C1–C3），并带有一个质量控制模块来评估生成的掩膜。使用来自 998 名对照和 879 名遗传性共济失调患者（32 个中心；年龄 5–85 岁；46% 男性）的 MRI 数据训练深度学习模型（nnU-Net、带深度监督的 U-Net、SwinUNETR），用于 C1–C3 水平的自动椎体标记。训练了一个基于 VGG、ResNet 和 EfficientNet 架构的次级模型来识别椎体标记错误。该流程还生成图像质量指标，包括信号噪声比、对比噪声比、联合变异系数和熵聚焦准则。使用来自四个公共数据集的 2737 例 MRI 进行外部验证，并在 51 例多发性硬化患者的纵向队列中证明临床实用性。nnU-Net 取得最高性能（Dice：C1 = 0.85，C2 = 0.89，C3 = 0.89），对来自 Spinal Cord Toolbox 的误标病例中的 95.8% 进行了标记。基于 VGG 的分类器达到 97.9% 准确率和 98.7% 灵敏度。外部验证显示，在五个数据集中的四个中标记准确率超过 92%，并对多发性硬化中的纵向 SC 萎缩敏感。该流程能够为多中心研究实现可扩展、可靠的上颈髓椎体标记和形态学提取，并支持神经退行性疾病中的生物标志物开发。

title: A hybrid framework for Turner Syndrome facial detection: integrating deep feature learning and geometric prior knowledge under data scarcity
zh_title: 深度特征与几何先验融合的特纳综合征人脸识别
summary: npj Digital Medicine 研究构建融合深度特征与几何先验的人脸识别筛查模型，回顾性构建并在前瞻队列中验证。
key_points: 面向染色体病特纳综合征的AI面部筛查框架
回顾性建模，另在前瞻队列中验证
reason: 同行评审+前瞻队列验证，符合重要档；但样本量未明、无临床结局，偏该档下缘
abstract: Turner Syndrome (TS) is a chromosomal disorder characterized by growth retardation and congenital ovarian dysgenesis. Given the considerable morbidity and mortality, early diagnosis and timely intervention are crucial to improving outcomes. However, the gold standard diagnostic method, karyotype analysis, is time-consuming and requires specialized laboratory expertise. Since TS patients often present distinct facial features, AI-based facial recognition could help identify patients with characteristic appearance as a screening tool. Inspired by the value-of-information principle, we propose a hybrid framework integrating deep feature learning and geometric prior knowledge under data scarcity. We retrospectively constructed this AI facial recognition model for TS detection and validated it in a prospective cohort. The proposed framework achieved 95.41% accuracy, 96.55% sensitivity, and 95.24% specificity, substantially simplifying the diagnostic process. When training was performed only on the hard subset obtained after difficulty-based stratification into three equal groups, the sensitivity reached 100.00%, indicating that all patients were correctly identified. Grad-CAM visualization of key facial regions improved model interpretability and aligned predictions with clinical insights. Our method offers a low-cost and easily accessible approach to TS screening. By allowing for an earlier detection of TS, particularly in medical resource-limited settings, this method has the potential to facilitate timely interventions. This novel paradigm also provides insight for facial recognition-aided diagnosis in other diseases.
zh_abstract: 特纳综合征（Turner Syndrome, TS）是一种以生长迟缓和先天性卵巢发育不全为特征的染色体疾病。鉴于其相当的发病率和死亡率，早期诊断和及时干预对于改善结局至关重要。然而，金标准诊断方法——核型分析——耗时且需要专业实验室技术。由于 TS 患者常具有独特的面部特征，基于人工智能的面部识别可作为一种筛查工具，帮助识别具有特征性外貌的患者。受信息价值原则启发，我们提出一种在数据稀缺条件下整合深度特征学习与几何先验知识的混合框架。我们回顾性构建了这一用于 TS 检测的人工智能面部识别模型，并在前瞻性队列中对其进行验证。所提出的框架达到 95.41% 的准确率、96.55% 的敏感度和 95.24% 的特异度，大幅简化了诊断流程。当仅在使用基于难度分层为三个相等组后获得的困难子集上进行训练时，敏感度达到 100.00%，表明所有患者均被正确识别。关键面部区域的 Grad-CAM 可视化提高了模型可解释性，并使预测与临床见解相一致。我们的方法为 TS 筛查提供了一种低成本且易于获取的途径。通过允许更早发现 TS，尤其是在医疗资源有限的环境中，该方法有潜力促进及时干预。这一新范式也为其他疾病中面部识别辅助诊断提供了启示。

title: From simulation to pedagogy: multi-model and randomized evaluation of structured AI standardized patients
zh_title: 多模型随机评估：结构化AI标准化病人

abstract: Standardized patients (SPs) are central to clinical communication training but remain constrained by cost, scalability, and reliance on trained actors. We present AI standardized patients (AI-SPs), large language model–driven patient simulators built on a three-layer information architecture that adaptively modulates information disclosure according to learner skill. In Phase 1, blinded expert assessment of 350 simulated consultations generated by five frontier LLMs showed that, under a common architecture, learner skill level accounted for more of the observed performance variation than model choice ( η ^2 = 0.31 vs. 0.06); whether this reflects the architecture itself cannot be determined without comparing models with and without it. In Phase 1b, analysis of 155 live student consultations identified systematic failures to elicit safety-critical information, enabling automated curriculum diagnostics without expert observation. In a Phase 2 three-arm pilot randomized study ( n = 58), OSCE performance gains with AI-SP training did not differ significantly from those with human SP training; the trial was designed to estimate effect sizes for a future confirmatory study, not to demonstrate equivalence. Self-efficacy gains were numerically largest with AI-SP training, but this exploratory difference did not survive correction for multiple comparisons. These findings suggest that architecture-driven AI-SPs could provide a scalable, model-portable approach to clinical communication training.
zh_abstract: 标准化患者（SPs）是临床沟通培训的核心，但仍受成本、可扩展性和对训练有素演员依赖的限制。我们提出AI标准化患者（AI-SPs），即由大语言模型驱动的患者模拟器，构建于三层信息架构之上，可根据学习者技能自适应调节信息披露。在Phase 1中，对五个前沿LLM生成的350次模拟问诊进行盲法专家评估显示，在共同架构下，学习者技能水平对观察到的表现变异的解释程度高于模型选择（η² = 0.31 vs. 0.06）；若不比较使用和不使用该架构的模型，则无法确定这是否反映了架构本身。在Phase 1b中，对155次真实学生问诊的分析识别出未能引出安全关键信息的系统性失败，使得无需专家观察即可进行自动化课程诊断。在一项Phase 2三臂试点随机研究（n = 58）中，AI-SP培训带来的OSCE表现提升与人类SP培训无显著差异；该试验旨在为未来确证性研究估计效应量，而非证明等效性。AI-SP培训的自我效能提升在数值上最大，但这一探索性差异未能在多重比较校正后保持。这些发现提示，架构驱动的AI-SPs可为临床沟通培训提供一种可扩展、模型可移植的方法。

abstract: [JACC. Advances] Artificial intelligence-electrocardiogram (ECG) algorithms are becoming increasingly powerful tools in the clinical world, allowing for earlier and subclinical detection of ubiquitous and harmful pathologies. However, the strength of these algorithms is directly informed by the strength of the data sets on which they are trained, and there is a growing need for large-scale, diverse, publicly available ECG repositories. The Duke Clinically Linked ECG and Arrhythmia Repository is a large-scale ECG database containing over 5 million clinically acquired ECGs linked to longitudinal clinical data. Its strengths-including demographic diversity, large sample size, linked clinical databases, breadth of represented conditions, access to linked procedure codes, various options for data export, and ease in creating targeted subcohorts-position it as a significant tool in the artificial intelligence-ECG research landscape. This Methods paper outlines the demographics and structure of this database and explores promising research applications of this resource.
zh_abstract: [JACC. Advances] 人工智能-心电图（ECG）算法正成为临床世界中越来越强大的工具，使得能够更早地和亚临床地检测普遍且有害的病理。然而，这些算法的强度直接取决于其训练所用数据集的强度，并且对大规模、多样化、公开可用的ECG数据库的需求日益增长。杜克临床关联心电图与心律失常数据库（Duke Clinically Linked ECG and Arrhythmia Repository）是一个大型ECG数据库，包含超过500万份临床获取的ECG，并与纵向临床数据相关联。其优势——包括人口统计学多样性、大样本量、关联的临床数据库、所代表疾病的广度、对关联操作代码的访问、多种数据导出选项以及易于创建目标亚队列——使其成为人工智能-ECG研究领域中的重要工具。本方法学论文概述了该数据库的人口统计学和结构，并探讨了该资源有前景的研究应用。

title: Association of ambient artificial intelligence scribe availability with patient instruction documentation and readability in ambulatory care.
source: PubMed · Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA

summary: 单中心回顾性队列分析约39万次门诊就诊，评估AI scribe对患者医嘱记录频率与可读性的影响。

abstract: [Journal of the American Medical Informatics Association : JAMIA] This retrospective cohort study evaluated the effect of an artificial intelligence (AI) scribe on patient instructions documentation in ambulatory internal medicine settings. We analyzed 391 061 adult encounters at a single medical center from December 2023 to July 2025. A difference-in-differences analysis estimated the relationship of AI scribe availability with patient instructions documentation frequency. Mixed-effects logistic regression estimated the association between encounter-level AI scribe utilization and documentation, adjusted for patient, clinician, and encounter characteristics. Length and readability were compared across instructions created by AI alone, clinicians assisted by AI, and clinicians alone. Character-level edit distances between AI drafts and final documentation were calculated. AI scribe availability was associated with a 10.5 percentage-point increase in patient instructions documentation frequency (P = .018), and encounter-level AI use was associated with higher odds of documentation (aOR 4.32; 95% CI, 4.14-4.50). AI instructions were longer than clinician-authored content (median 1994 vs 482 characters) and scored higher on 3 text-complexity indices (all P < .001). Clinician editing of AI content increased length without meaningfully reducing complexity. AI drafts and final documentation differed substantially, with a median character-level edit distance of 39.7%. AI scribe availability was associated with increased patient instructions documentation. However, AI-generated instructions were longer and scored as more linguistically complex than clinician-authored instructions, and clinician editing did not close this gap. Ambient AI scribes can improve availability but may increase complexity of patient instructions. Research into downstream effects including patient comprehension and satisfaction is warranted.
zh_abstract: [《美国医学信息学协会杂志：JAMIA》] 这项回顾性队列研究评估了人工智能（AI）记录助手（AI scribe）对门诊内科环境中患者指导记录的影响。我们分析了2023年12月至2025年7月期间在单一医疗中心的391 061次成人就诊。双重差分分析估计了AI记录助手的可用性与患者指导记录频率之间的关系。混合效应逻辑回归估计了就诊层面AI记录助手使用与记录之间的关联，并校正了患者、临床医生和就诊特征。比较了仅由AI创建、临床医生在AI辅助下创建以及仅由临床医生创建的患者指导在长度和可读性方面的差异。计算了AI草稿与最终记录之间的字符级编辑距离。AI记录助手的可用性与患者指导记录频率增加10.5个百分点相关（P = .018），就诊层面AI使用与更高的记录比值比相关（aOR 4.32；95% CI，4.14-4.50）。AI生成的指导比临床医生撰写的内容更长（中位数1994个字符 vs 482个字符），并且在3项文本复杂度指数上得分更高（所有P < .001）。临床医生对AI内容的编辑增加了长度，但未有意义地降低复杂度。AI草稿与最终记录差异显著，字符级编辑距离中位数为39.7%。AI记录助手的可用性与患者指导记录增加相关。然而，AI生成的指导比临床医生撰写的指导更长，且评分显示其在语言上更复杂，临床医生的编辑并未缩小这一差距。环境式AI记录助手可以提高可用性，但可能增加患者指导的复杂度。有必要研究下游影响，包括患者理解和满意度。

title: Large language models for multimodal clinical predictive modeling: a systematic review

summary: 系统综述纳入57项研究，归纳LLM融合电子病历多模态数据的三种策略及性能增益。

融合策略分嵌入、抽取、文本融合三类
多模态较单模态平均提升约6.4%
reason: 系统综述纳入57项研究、结论明确，但为二手证据，综述上限档
abstract: The electronic health record (EHR) comprises structured and unstructured data, both of which are integral for comprehensively representing patient history. The emergence of large language models (LLMs) has enabled the incorporation of unstructured data modalities into machine learning models that leverage EHR data. In this systematic review, we characterize studies that utilize LLM-enabled multimodal predictive modeling with EHR data. Following a screening of 641 studies, 57 met inclusion criteria. We identified three strategies for LLM-based multimodal integration: embedding, extraction, and text fusion. Delineated by the format of the unstructured data at the time of fusion, all strategies yielded performance gains (average 6.4% increase) over single modality models. LLMs facilitated modeling by generating note-embeddings for downstream prediction, extracting clinically informative variables, and summarizing long text documents prior to integration. Building on our review, we identified LLM-enhanced predictive modeling considerations that include sample size, interpretability, and computational costs. This study supports the potential value of LLMs for EHR-based predictive modeling and provides a framework for future multimodal modeling tools.
zh_abstract: 电子健康记录（electronic health record, EHR）包含结构化和非结构化数据，二者对于全面表征患者病史均不可或缺。大语言模型（large language models, LLMs）的出现使得能够将非结构化数据模态纳入利用 EHR 数据的机器学习模型。在本系统综述中，我们描述了利用基于 LLM 的多模态预测建模并使用 EHR 数据的研究特征。在筛选 641 项研究后，57 项符合纳入标准。我们识别了三种基于 LLM 的多模态整合策略：嵌入、提取和文本融合。按融合时非结构化数据的格式划分，所有策略均较单模态模型取得性能提升（平均增加 6.4%）。LLMs 通过生成用于下游预测的病历记录嵌入、提取具有临床信息价值的变量，以及在整合前总结长文本文件，促进了建模。基于我们的综述，我们识别了 LLM 增强预测建模的考虑因素，包括样本量、可解释性和计算成本。本研究支持 LLMs 在基于 EHR 的预测建模中的潜在价值，并为未来多模态建模工具提供了框架。

title: Artificial Intelligence-Enhanced Colposcopy Training Improves Diagnostic Reasoning and Communication Competencies: A Randomized Controlled Study.
source: PubMed · Journal of gynecology obstetrics and human reproduction
zh_title: AI虚拟患者提升阴道镜培训效果
summary: 两院60名住院医师随机对照试验：AI虚拟患者平台改善阴道镜诊断推理与沟通能力。
key_points: 随机、评估者盲法、等待对照设计

主要结局为诊断推理与沟通能力
reason: RCT设计但样本仅60人、单领域培训，属值得一看档
abstract: [Journal of gynecology obstetrics and human reproduction] Cervical cancer remains a major global health issue, and colposcopy training struggles with standardization and scalability. AI has potential to improve medical education, but its effectiveness in colposcopy training remains underexplored. To evaluate the efficacy of an artificial intelligence (AI)-driven virtual patient platform for colposcopy training among resident physicians. In this randomized, assessor-blinded, wait-list-controlled trial, 60 obstetrics and gynecology residents (PGY-2/3) from two affiliated teaching hospitals were enrolled (May 2023-September 2025). Participants were randomly assigned to either the Immediate AI Intervention group (traditional teaching plus an AI platform throughout) or the Wait-List Control group (traditional teaching only during Month 1, followed by the AI platform). The primary outcome was the between-group difference in the Case Analysis score at 1 month. Secondary outcomes included theoretical knowledge, communication performance, diagnostic justification, and operative competence assessed via OSCE. At 1 month, the Immediate AI group showed superior performance in Case Analysis (78.57 ± 3.72 vs 71.03 ± 5.82, mean difference = 7.54, p<0.001, Cohen's d=1.54), Diagnostic Justification (81.63 ± 6.21 vs 74.13 ± 6.77, p<0.001, Cohen's d=1.15), Communication Performance (80.97 ± 3.90 vs 75.77 ± 6.08, p<0.001, Cohen's d=1.02), and Theoretical Knowledge (84.67 ± 6.27 vs 80.43 ± 5.07, p=0.006, Cohen's d=0.74). Operative competence showed no significant difference (p = 0.113). Both groups achieved high proficiency (over 85 points) within 3 months. Satisfaction was high (90.0% participants, 91.7% supervisors). An AI-driven virtual patient platform significantly accelerates the acquisition of diagnostic reasoning and communication skills in colposcopy training, demonstrating high educational efficacy and acceptance for scalable, standardized education.
zh_abstract: [Journal of gynecology obstetrics and human reproduction] 宫颈癌仍是一个主要的全球健康问题，而阴道镜培训在标准化和可扩展性方面面临困难。AI有潜力改善医学教育，但其在阴道镜培训中的有效性仍研究不足。为评估人工智能（AI）驱动的虚拟患者平台在住院医师阴道镜培训中的疗效。在这项随机、评估者盲法、等待列表对照试验中，来自两家附属教学医院的60名妇产科住院医师（PGY-2/3）被纳入（2023年5月至2025年9月）。参与者被随机分配到立即AI干预组（全程传统教学加AI平台）或等待列表对照组（第1个月仅传统教学，随后使用AI平台）。主要结局是1个月时病例分析评分的组间差异。次要结局包括通过OSCE评估的理论知识、沟通表现、诊断论证和操作能力。在1个月时，立即AI组在病例分析（78.57 ± 3.72 对 71.03 ± 5.82，平均差 = 7.54，p<0.001，Cohen's d=1.54）、诊断论证（81.63 ± 6.21 对 74.13 ± 6.77，p<0.001，Cohen's d=1.15）、沟通表现（80.97 ± 3.90 对 75.77 ± 6.08，p<0.001，Cohen's d=1.02）和理论知识（84.67 ± 6.27 对 80.43 ± 5.07，p=0.006，Cohen's d=0.74）方面表现出更优表现。操作能力无显著差异（p = 0.113）。两组均在3个月内达到高熟练度（超过85分）。满意度很高（90.0%参与者，91.7%督导者）。AI驱动的虚拟患者平台显著加速了阴道镜培训中诊断推理和沟通技能的获得，显示出高的教育效果和接受度，可用于可扩展、标准化的教育。

title: Clinical AI governance for scalable innovation in value based healthcare systems
zh_title: 价值医疗体系中的临床AI治理框架C-TACT
summary: 提出C-TACT治理框架，按人员、流程、技术三支柱与四阶段生命周期加权评分管理临床AI。
key_points: 三支柱与四阶段生命周期结构
阶段评分卡采用层次分析法加权
回溯示例区分两组部署与对照
reason: 治理框架类文章，仅回溯示意应用，证据有限
abstract: Health systems are deploying clinical artificial intelligence (AI) faster than they can govern it, and existing frameworks emphasize risk oversight over operational learning and scale. The Collaborative Technology Adoption for Care Transformation (C-TACT) framework, developed at Southern California Permanente Medical Group (SCPMG), organizes governance across three pillars (People, Process, Technology) and four lifecycle stages (Vendor Evaluation, Pilot, Scale, Maintenance), each operationalized through a domain-weighted scorecard. Scale and Maintenance scorecards incorporate business and operational execution as weighted domains, with Analytic Hierarchy Process methods (consistency ratio 0.0037). In an illustrative, retrospective application, the Pilot Score Card separated two published SCPMG AI deployments and four anonymized comparators (47.0–53.5) by approximately thirty points across three weighting schemes. This separation illustrates how the framework behaves in this comparison. It is not evidence of validated discriminative performance, because the comparator scores were reconstructed retrospectively and were not scored under blinded conditions. C-TACT is presented here as a governance framework and a methodological demonstration. Prospective, blinded validation is needed to establish its discriminative and predictive performance under real-world conditions.
zh_abstract: 卫生系统部署临床人工智能（AI）的速度快于其治理能力，现有框架强调风险监督，而非运营学习与规模化。协作式照护转型技术采纳（Collaborative Technology Adoption for Care Transformation，C-TACT）框架由南加州永久医疗集团（Southern California Permanente Medical Group，SCPMG）开发，将治理组织为三大支柱（人员、流程、技术）和四个生命周期阶段（供应商评估、试点、规模化、维护），每个支柱和阶段均通过领域加权评分卡进行操作化。规模化和维护评分卡将业务和运营执行作为加权领域纳入，并采用层次分析法（Analytic Hierarchy Process）方法（一致性比率0.0037）。在一项说明性回顾性应用中，试点评分卡（Pilot Score Card）在三种权重方案下将两个已发表的SCPMG AI部署与四个匿名比较对象（47.0–53.5）区分开，差距约为三十分。这种区分说明了该框架在此比较中的表现。它并非经过验证的判别性能证据，因为比较对象评分是回顾性重建的，且未在盲法条件下评分。本文提出的C-TACT是一个治理框架和方法学示范。需要前瞻性、盲法验证以确定其在真实世界条件下的判别性能和预测性能。

title: Computational Peptide Design: Emerging Concepts in Antibiotics, Immunity, and Evolution.
zh_title: 计算肽设计在抗生素、免疫与演化中的新概念
summary: 综述AI方法挖掘基因组与蛋白组中的抗菌肽，并用于活性预测、序列优化与从头设计。
key_points: AI可从基因组与古序列中挖掘抗菌肽
涵盖活性预测与从头肽生成方法
讨论干湿实验闭环设计流程
reason: 同行评审综述，内容系统但非原始研究，综述上限档
abstract: [Annual review of microbiology] Peptides are among the smallest functional biomolecules. Learning to systematically design their activity would revolutionize biology and medicine. Yet achieving this goal remains an open challenge. Recent advances in machine learning enable the discovery and design of peptides at scale, not only yielding new antibiotic agents effective against priority pathogens but also revealing unexpected roles for peptides in host immunity. In this review, we survey how artificial intelligence (AI) methods can be used to mine genomes, proteomes, and even ancient sequence data to uncover "encrypted" peptide antibiotics across the tree of life and over evolutionary time. We highlight emerging approaches for activity prediction, structure-activity modeling, sequence optimization, and de novo peptide generation, and we discuss workflows that tightly couple in silico design with high-throughput experimental validation. We further introduce the concept of "encrypted immunity," in which ordinary proteins encode latent antimicrobial fragments, and we outline translational opportunities as well as remaining challenges on the path to bringing AI-designed peptides to the clinic.
zh_abstract: [Annual review of microbiology] 肽是最小的功能性生物分子之一。学会系统地设计其活性将彻底改变生物学和医学。然而，实现这一目标仍是一个未解决的挑战。机器学习的近期进展使得能够大规模发现和设计肽，不仅产生了对优先病原体有效的新的抗生素药物，还揭示了肽在宿主免疫中意想不到的作用。在本综述中，我们考察如何使用人工智能（artificial intelligence, AI）方法挖掘基因组、蛋白质组甚至古老序列数据，以发现跨越生命之树和进化时间的“加密”肽抗生素。我们重点介绍用于活性预测、结构-活性建模、序列优化和从头肽生成的新兴方法，并讨论将计算机（in silico）设计与高通量实验验证紧密耦合的工作流程。我们进一步引入“加密免疫”的概念，即普通蛋白质编码潜在的抗菌片段，并概述将AI设计的肽带入临床的转化机会以及尚存挑战。

zh_title: 轻量开源推理大模型用于文献筛选
summary: JAMIA Open 研究以专家双人筛选为参考标准，评测 gpt-oss-20b 对 20118 条文献记录的筛选性能与效率，F1 0.83–0.94、敏感度 90%–95%，速度快于人工。

abstract: [JAMIA open] To evaluate performance and efficiency of a lightweight open-source reasoning large language model (LLM) against an expert-derived reference standard for screening scientific publication databases. Two expert reviewers screened subsets of database records across 3 stages: (1) base eligibility (n = 200), (2) obesity focus (n = 200), and (3) women of reproductive age focus (n = 150). The LLM (gpt-oss-20b) screened all records (n = 20 118). Performance (F1-score and sensitivity [recall]) and efficiency (average screening rate) were assessed. Interreader agreement was near-perfect ( κ : 0.99-1.00; all P < .001). LLM performance was high: F1-score, 0.83-0.94; sensitivity, 90%-95%; specificity, 86%-99%; accuracy, 89%-94%; precision, 77%-99%; and negative predictive value (NPV), 89%-96%. LLM screening was faster than reviewers (19.4 vs ∼1.0 records/min). The LLM achieved high performance and efficiency relative to an expert-derived reference standard for screening. The use of lightweight open-source reasoning LLMs shows promise to support screening in evidence synthesis workflows.
zh_abstract: [JAMIA open] 为评估一种轻量级开源推理大语言模型（LLM）相对于专家制定的参考标准在筛选科学出版物数据库中的性能和效率。两名专家评审员分 3 个阶段筛选数据库记录子集：（1）基本合格性（n = 200），（2）肥胖重点（n = 200），（3）育龄女性重点（n = 150）。LLM（gpt-oss-20b）筛选了所有记录（n = 20 118）。评估了性能（F1 分数和灵敏度[召回率]）和效率（平均筛选速率）。评审者间一致性接近完美（κ：0.99-1.00；所有 P < .001）。LLM 性能很高：F1 分数为 0.83-0.94；灵敏度为 90%-95%；特异度为 86%-99%；准确率为 89%-94%；精确率为 77%-99%；阴性预测值（NPV）为 89%-96%。LLM 筛选比评审员更快（19.4 vs ∼1.0 条记录/分钟）。相对于专家制定的参考标准，LLM 在筛选中取得了高性能和高效率。轻量级开源推理 LLM 的使用显示出支持证据合成工作流程中筛选的潜力。

title: Multi-scale integration identifies an ox-LDL-autophagy-inflammasome framework linking osteoporosis and neurodegeneration
zh_title: 多尺度整合揭示骨质疏松与神经退行关联
summary: 整合多组学、单细胞与ODE建模，提示ox-LDL-自噬-炎症小体轴连接骨质疏松与神经退行。
key_points: 跨组织多组学与单细胞转录组整合

abstract: Osteoporosis (OP) and neurodegeneration frequently co-occur with advancing age, but the biological processes linking skeletal and neurological decline remain incompletely understood. To investigate the metabolic-inflammatory axis connecting skeletal and neurological degeneration, we integrated cross-tissue multi-omics, single-cell transcriptomics, in vitro macrophage assays, and systems-level ordinary differential equation (ODE)-based modeling. Population-level and genetically informed analyses consistently implicated metabolic burden and lipid-associated stress in both disease domains, whereas physical activity showed protective associations. Cross-tissue and single-cell analyses identified convergent autophagy- and inflammasome-related programs, while cross-tissue multi-omics highlighted a PHF23-MCL1-CLN3 autophagy-associated molecular module. In RAW264.7 macrophages, oxidized low-density lipoprotein (ox-LDL) exposure induced inflammatory activation, pro-inflammatory polarization, and autophagy-associated dysregulation, while PHF23 perturbation modified ox-LDL-induced inflammatory responses. A 12-state ODE model further provided a hypothesis-generating representation of dynamic interactions among ox-LDL-associated metabolic stress, autophagy regulation, inflammasome activation, macrophage polarization, and tissue-damage-related states. Together, these multi-scale findings provide convergent support for an ox-LDL-autophagy-inflammasome-associated framework linking metabolic dysfunction with skeletal and neurological degeneration and generate testable hypotheses for further experimental investigation.
zh_abstract: 骨质疏松症（OP）和神经退行性变常随年龄增长而共同发生，但连接骨骼和神经功能衰退的生物学过程仍未被完全理解。为研究连接骨骼和神经退行性变的代谢-炎症轴，我们整合了跨组织多组学、单细胞转录组学、体外巨噬细胞实验以及基于常微分方程（ODE）的系统级建模。群体水平和遗传信息指导的分析一致表明代谢负担和脂质相关应激在两个疾病领域均有关联，而体力活动显示出保护性关联。跨组织和单细胞分析识别出趋同的自噬和炎症小体相关程序，而跨组织多组学突出显示了一个 PHF23-MCL1-CLN3 自噬相关分子模块。在 RAW264.7 巨噬细胞中，氧化低密度脂蛋白（ox-LDL）暴露诱导炎症激活、促炎极化和自噬相关失调，而 PHF23 扰动改变了 ox-LDL 诱导的炎症反应。一个12状态 ODE 模型进一步提供了一种产生假设的表示，描述 ox-LDL 相关代谢应激、自噬调节、炎症小体激活、巨噬细胞极化和组织损伤相关状态之间的动态相互作用。总之，这些多尺度发现为连接代谢功能障碍与骨骼和神经退行性变的 ox-LDL-自噬-炎症小体相关框架提供了趋同支持，并为进一步实验研究产生了可检验的假设。

title: Reporting of Fairness and Equity in Studies of Regulator-cleared Commercial AI for Acute Stroke CT: A Systematic Review.
zh_title: 急性卒中CT商业AI研究的公平性报告系统综述
summary: 系统综述评估FDA等监管已批准卒中CT商业AI工具研究中，是否报告不同人群间的性能差异。
